source.text: Διὰ τοῦτο δεῖ περισσοτέρως προσέχειν ἡμᾶς τοῖς ἀκουσθεῖσιν, μήποτε παραρυῶμεν.

records.literal_gloss: Because of this it is necessary more abundantly to pay attention us to the things heard, lest we drift away.

en.L: Because of this it is necessary [for] us to pay attention more abundantly to the things heard, lest we drift away.
en.B: This is why we must give even greater attention to the things we have heard, so that we do not drift off.
en.R: So we must listen even more carefully to the message we have heard. Then we will not slowly drift away from it.

es.L: Por esto es necesario que nosotros prestemos atención más abundantemente a las cosas oídas, no sea que vayamos a la deriva.
es.B: Por eso debemos prestar una atención todavía mayor a lo que hemos oído, para no irnos a la deriva.
es.R: Así que debemos escuchar con todavía más cuidado el mensaje que hemos oído. Así no nos iremos alejando de él poco a poco.

fr.L: À cause de cela il faut [que] nous prêtions attention plus abondamment aux choses entendues, de peur que nous ne dérivions.
fr.B: C’est pourquoi nous devons prêter une attention plus grande encore à ce que nous avons entendu, pour ne pas partir à la dérive.
fr.R: Nous devons donc écouter encore plus attentivement le message que nous avons entendu. Ainsi, nous ne dériverons pas lentement loin de lui.

sw.L: Kwa sababu hii inatupasa sisi kuyazingatia kwa wingi zaidi mambo yaliyosikiwa, tusije tukaelea mbali.
sw.B: Hii ndiyo sababu tunapaswa kuyazingatia hata zaidi mambo tuliyoyasikia, ili tusije tukaelea mbali.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo tunapaswa kusikiliza kwa makini zaidi ujumbe tuliousikia. Ndipo hatutaelea mbali nao polepole.

vi.L: Vì cớ đó, chúng ta cần phải chú ý nhiều hơn nữa đến những điều đã nghe, kẻo chúng ta trôi giạt mất.
vi.B: Vì vậy, chúng ta càng phải chú tâm hơn nữa vào những điều chúng ta đã nghe, để khỏi bị trôi giạt xa.
vi.R: Vì vậy, chúng ta phải lắng nghe sứ điệp mình đã nghe một cách cẩn thận hơn nữa. Như thế chúng ta sẽ không dần dần trôi xa khỏi sứ điệp ấy.

ko.L: 이 때문에 우리는 들은 것들에 더욱더 주의를 기울여야 합니다. 그렇지 않으면 우리가 떠내려갈지도 모릅니다.
ko.B: 그러므로 우리는 우리가 들은 것에 더욱 주의를 기울여야 합니다. 그래야 우리가 떠내려가지 않을 것입니다.
ko.R: 그러므로 우리는 우리가 들은 말씀에 더욱 귀를 기울여야 합니다. 그러면 우리가 그 말씀에서 조금씩 멀어져 떠내려가지 않을 것입니다.

pt.L: Por isso é preciso que nós prestemos atenção mais abundantemente às coisas ouvidas, para que não fiquemos à deriva.
pt.B: É por isso que devemos dar atenção ainda maior ao que ouvimos, para que não fiquemos à deriva.
pt.R: Por isso precisamos ouvir com ainda mais cuidado a mensagem que ouvimos. Assim não vamos nos afastar dela aos poucos, como um barco que fica à deriva.

am.L: ስለዚህ ተንሳፍፈን እንዳንወሰድ ለተሰሙት ነገሮች እጅግ አብልጠን ልናስተውል ያስፈልገናል።
am.B: ስለዚህ ተንሳፍፈን እንዳንወሰድ፣ ለሰማነው ነገር የበለጠ ትኩረት ልንሰጥ ይገባናል።
am.R: ስለዚህ የሰማነውን መልእክት ይበልጥ በጥንቃቄ ልናዳምጥ ይገባናል። ያን ጊዜ ቀስ በቀስ ተንሳፍፈን ከእርሱ አንርቅም።

decisions.choice: because of this: because the Son is so far above the angels
decisions.reason: "Because of this" draws the lesson from chapter 1. The message God has spoken in the Son (1:2) carries more weight than the message given through angels (2:2), so it calls for closer attention.

decisions.choice: drift away: slip away gradually, like a boat carried past its mooring
decisions.reason: παραρρέω means "flow past, slip away", and was used of a boat drifting off course or of something slipping from the mind. The danger is not open rebellion but slow carelessness, which verse 3 calls "neglect". προσέχω, "pay attention to, hold to", could also be used of bringing a ship in to anchor.

decisions.choice: the things heard: the message of salvation the readers received
decisions.reason: The things heard are the message first spoken by the Lord and passed on to the readers by those who heard him (verse 3).

decisions.choice: slowly drift away from it
decisions.reason: Readable adds "slowly" and "from it" to bring out the picture of gradual drifting (m2).

decisions.choice: ir a la deriva
decisions.reason: "Ir a la deriva" is said of a boat carried along by the current with nothing holding it, the picture of m2, and is also used of people who lose their way little by little.

decisions.choice: tukaelea mbali (drift away)
decisions.reason: "Kuelea mbali" is what a boat does when the current carries it away, which keeps the picture of meaning decision m2. "Kukosa" (miss) or "kupotea" (get lost) would lose the slow, unnoticed movement.

decisions.choice: "trôi giạt" (L, B); "dần dần trôi xa" (R)
decisions.reason: The verb pictures a boat slipping past its mooring (m2). "Trôi giạt" keeps the picture of being carried off by the current without meaning to; "sa ngã" would turn it into a fall into sin.

decisions.choice: "떠내려가다" for drift away, at every level
decisions.reason: To drift away is to slip away gradually, like a boat carried past its mooring (meaning decision); "떠내려가다" keeps that picture, and Readable adds what the readers drift away from, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: fiquemos à deriva (L, B); nos afastar dela aos poucos, como um barco que fica à deriva (R)
decisions.reason: "Ficar à deriva" is the Portuguese picture of a boat carried off by the current, the image m2 describes: slow carelessness rather than rebellion. Readable spells the picture out, since the English Readable adds "slowly".

decisions.choice: ተንሳፍፈን እንዳንወሰድ (lest we be carried off, floating)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision pictures a boat slipping past its mooring; "ተንሳፍፈን መወሰድ" keeps the picture of being carried off slowly, where "መሳት" would speak of losing the way.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the English deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change in Amharic in this chapter.

source.text: εἰ γὰρ ὁ δι’ ἀγγέλων λαληθεὶς λόγος ἐγένετο βέβαιος, καὶ πᾶσα παράβασις καὶ παρακοὴ ἔλαβεν ἔνδικον μισθαποδοσίαν, πῶς ἡμεῖς ἐκφευξόμεθα τηλικαύτης ἀμελήσαντες σωτηρίας, ἥτις, ἀρχὴν λαβοῦσα λαλεῖσθαι διὰ τοῦ κυρίου, ὑπὸ τῶν ἀκουσάντων εἰς ἡμᾶς ἐβεβαιώθη, συνεπιμαρτυροῦντος τοῦ θεοῦ σημείοις τε καὶ τέρασιν καὶ ποικίλαις δυνάμεσιν καὶ πνεύματος ἁγίου μερισμοῖς κατὰ τὴν αὐτοῦ θέλησιν;

records.literal_gloss: If for the through angels having been spoken word was firm, and every transgression and disobedience received a just recompense, \v 3 how we will escape so great having neglected a salvation, which, a beginning having received to be spoken through the Lord, by those having heard to us was confirmed, \v 4 bearing witness with [them] the God by signs both and wonders and various powers and of [the] Spirit Holy distributions according to the of him will?

en.L: For if the word spoken through angels was firm, and every transgression and disobedience received a just recompense, \v 3 how will we escape, having neglected so great a salvation, which, having received a beginning [in] being spoken through the Lord, was confirmed to us by those who heard, \v 4 God bearing witness with [them] by both signs and wonders and various powers and distributions of [the] Holy Spirit according to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} will?
en.B: For if the word that was spoken through angels held good, and every breach of it and every refusal to listen met with the penalty it deserved, \v 3 how will we escape if we pay no attention to a salvation as great as this? The Lord was the first to speak of it, and it was made certain to us by those who had listened to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, \v 4 while God added {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own testimony by signs and wonders, by many kinds of mighty works, and by sharing out the Holy Spirit as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} chose.
en.R: God gave {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} law through angels, and that message stood firm. Everyone who broke it or refused to obey it was punished as they deserved. \v 3 So how will we escape if we ignore such a great salvation? The Lord Jesus was the first to tell about this salvation. Then the people who heard {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} told it to us and showed us that it is true. \v 4 God also showed that it is true. He did signs and wonders and all kinds of miracles. And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gave gifts of the Holy Spirit to people, just as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} wanted.

es.L: Porque si la palabra dicha por medio de ángeles fue firme, y toda transgresión y desobediencia recibió una justa retribución, \v 3 ¿cómo escaparemos nosotros, habiendo descuidado una salvación tan grande, la cual, habiendo recibido [su] comienzo al ser anunciada por medio del Señor, nos fue confirmada por los que oyeron, \v 4 dando Dios testimonio juntamente [con ellos] con señales y prodigios y diversas obras de poder y repartos del Espíritu Santo según {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} voluntad?
es.B: Porque si la palabra dicha por medio de ángeles se mantuvo firme, y toda infracción de ella y toda negativa a escuchar recibió el castigo merecido, \v 3 ¿cómo escaparemos nosotros si no hacemos caso de una salvación tan grande? El Señor fue el primero en anunciarla, y nos la confirmaron los que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} habían escuchado, \v 4 mientras Dios añadía {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} propio testimonio con señales y prodigios, con muchas clases de obras poderosas y repartiendo el Espíritu Santo como {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} quiso.
es.R: Dios dio {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ley por medio de ángeles, y ese mensaje se mantuvo firme. Todo el que la quebrantó o se negó a obedecerla recibió el castigo que merecía. \v 3 Entonces, ¿cómo vamos a escapar nosotros si no hacemos caso de una salvación tan grande? El Señor Jesús fue el primero que habló de esta salvación. Luego los que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} oyeron nos la anunciaron y nos mostraron que es verdad. \v 4 Dios también mostró que es verdad. Hizo señales y prodigios y toda clase de milagros. Y dio dones del Espíritu Santo a las personas, como {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} quiso.

fr.L: Car si la parole annoncée par des anges a été ferme, et si toute transgression et désobéissance a reçu un juste salaire, \v 3 comment, nous, échapperons-nous, ayant négligé un si grand salut, qui, ayant reçu [son] commencement en étant annoncé par le Seigneur, nous a été confirmé par ceux qui ont entendu, \v 4 Dieu rendant témoignage avec [eux] par des signes et des prodiges et des miracles divers et des répartitions de [l’]Esprit Saint selon {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} volonté ?
fr.B: Car si la parole annoncée par des anges est restée valable, et si toute infraction et tout refus d’écouter ont reçu la peine qu’ils méritaient, \v 3 comment échapperons-nous si nous ne faisons aucun cas d’un salut aussi grand ? C’est le Seigneur qui l’a annoncé le premier, et ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}avaient écouté nous l’ont garanti, \v 4 tandis que Dieu y ajoutait {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} propre témoignage par des signes et des prodiges, par toutes sortes d’œuvres puissantes et en distribuant l’Esprit Saint comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’a voulu.
fr.R: Dieu a donné {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} loi par des anges, et ce message est resté ferme. Tous ceux qui ne l’ont pas respectée ou qui ont refusé de lui obéir ont été punis comme ils le méritaient. \v 3 Alors comment échapperons-nous si nous ne faisons pas attention à un salut si grand ? Le Seigneur Jésus a été le premier à parler de ce salut. Ensuite, ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}ont entendu nous l’ont annoncé et nous ont montré que c’est vrai. \v 4 Dieu a aussi montré que c’est vrai. Il a fait des signes, des prodiges et toutes sortes de miracles. Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a donné des dons de l’Esprit Saint aux gens, comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} le voulait.

sw.L: Kwa maana ikiwa neno lililonenwa kupitia malaika lilikuwa imara, na kila uvunjaji na ukaidi ulipokea malipo yaliyostahili, \v 3 sisi tutaepukaje, tukiwa tumeupuuza wokovu mkubwa kiasi hiki, ambao, ukiwa umeanza kunenwa kupitia Bwana, ulithibitishwa kwetu na wale waliosikia, \v 4 Mungu akishuhudia pamoja [nao] kwa ishara na maajabu na matendo mbalimbali ya nguvu na kwa migawo ya Roho Mtakatifu kulingana na mapenzi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}?
sw.B: Kwa maana ikiwa neno lililonenwa kupitia malaika lilisimama imara, na kila kulivunja na kila kukataa kulisikiliza kulipata adhabu iliyostahili, \v 3 tutaepukaje sisi tukiupuuza wokovu mkubwa kama huu? Bwana ndiye aliyekuwa wa kwanza kuunena, nao ukathibitishwa kwetu na wale waliomsikiliza, \v 4 huku Mungu naye akiongeza ushuhuda {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} kwa ishara na maajabu, kwa matendo ya nguvu ya kila aina, na kwa kugawa Roho Mtakatifu kama {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} alivyopenda.
sw.R: Mungu alitoa sheria {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kupitia malaika, na ujumbe huo ulisimama imara. Kila aliyeivunja au kukataa kuitii aliadhibiwa kama alivyostahili. \v 3 Basi tutaepukaje tukiupuuza wokovu mkubwa namna hii? Bwana Yesu ndiye aliyekuwa wa kwanza kuwaeleza watu habari za wokovu huu. Kisha wale waliomsikia walituambia habari hizo, wakatuonyesha kwamba ni kweli. \v 4 Mungu naye alionyesha kwamba ni kweli. Alifanya ishara na maajabu na miujiza ya kila aina. Tena aliwapa watu vipawa vya Roho Mtakatifu, kama {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} alivyotaka.

vi.L: Vì nếu lời đã được phán qua các thiên sứ là vững chắc, và mọi sự vi phạm cùng sự không vâng lời đều đã nhận lấy sự báo trả công minh, \v 3 thì làm sao chúng ta thoát được, nếu đã xem thường sự cứu rỗi lớn lao như vậy? Sự cứu rỗi ấy, ban đầu được Chúa rao giảng, rồi được những người đã nghe [{{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}] xác nhận cho chúng ta, \v 4 trong khi Đức Chúa Trời cùng làm chứng bằng các dấu lạ, các việc phi thường, các việc quyền năng khác nhau và bằng sự phân phát Đức Thánh Linh theo ý muốn {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Vì nếu lời đã được phán qua các thiên sứ có hiệu lực, và mọi sự vi phạm cùng mọi sự không chịu nghe đều đã phải chịu hình phạt đích đáng, \v 3 thì làm sao chúng ta thoát được, nếu chúng ta không lưu tâm đến một sự cứu rỗi lớn lao như vậy? Chính Chúa là Đấng đầu tiên đã phán về sự cứu rỗi ấy, và những người đã nghe {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã xác nhận điều ấy cho chúng ta, \v 4 trong khi Đức Chúa Trời cũng làm chứng thêm bằng các dấu lạ, các việc phi thường, bằng nhiều loại việc quyền năng, và bằng cách ban phát Đức Thánh Linh theo ý {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} muốn.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời đã ban luật pháp của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} qua các thiên sứ, và sứ điệp ấy đứng vững. Ai vi phạm luật ấy hay không chịu vâng theo đều bị trừng phạt đúng như họ đáng chịu. \v 3 Vậy làm sao chúng ta thoát được nếu chúng ta bỏ qua một sự cứu rỗi lớn lao như thế? Chính Chúa Giê-xu là Đấng đầu tiên đã nói về sự cứu rỗi này. Rồi những người đã nghe {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} kể lại cho chúng ta và cho chúng ta thấy đó là sự thật. \v 4 Đức Chúa Trời cũng cho thấy đó là sự thật. Ngài đã làm những dấu lạ, những việc phi thường và đủ mọi loại phép lạ. Ngài cũng ban các ân tứ của Đức Thánh Linh cho người ta, đúng theo ý {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} muốn.

ko.L: 만일 천사들을 통하여 하신 말씀이 확고하였고, 모든 범법과 불순종이 공정한 보응을 받았다면, \v 3 이렇게 큰 구원을 소홀히 여기고서 우리가 어떻게 피할 수 있겠습니까? 이 구원은 주님을 통하여 처음 말씀되기 시작하였고, 들은 사람들이 우리에게 확증하여 주었으며, \v 4 하나님께서도 표적들과 놀라운 일들과 여러 가지 능력들과, 그분의 뜻을 따라 성령을 나누어 주심으로 함께 증언하셨습니다.
ko.B: 천사들을 통하여 주신 말씀도 효력이 있어서, 그것을 어기거나 듣기를 거부한 사람은 누구나 마땅한 벌을 받았습니다. \v 3 그렇다면 이렇게 큰 구원을 소홀히 여기는 우리가 어떻게 벌을 피할 수 있겠습니까? 이 구원은 주님께서 처음으로 말씀하셨고, 그분의 말씀을 들은 사람들이 우리에게 확실하게 전해 주었습니다. \v 4 하나님께서도 표적과 놀라운 일과 여러 가지 능력 있는 일로, 그리고 그분의 뜻대로 성령을 나누어 주심으로 함께 증언하셨습니다.
ko.R: 하나님께서는 천사들을 통하여 율법을 주셨고, 그 말씀은 굳게 섰습니다. 그 율법을 어기거나 순종하기를 거부한 사람은 모두 마땅한 벌을 받았습니다. \v 3 그러니 우리가 이렇게 큰 구원을 무시한다면 어떻게 벌을 피할 수 있겠습니까? 이 구원에 대하여 처음으로 말씀하신 분은 주 예수님이십니다. 그다음에 그분의 말씀을 들은 사람들이 그것을 우리에게 전해 주었고, 그것이 참되다는 것을 보여 주었습니다. \v 4 하나님께서도 그것이 참되다는 것을 보여 주셨습니다. 하나님께서는 표적과 놀라운 일과 온갖 기적을 행하셨습니다. 또 그분이 원하시는 대로 사람들에게 성령의 선물을 나누어 주셨습니다.

pt.L: Pois, se a palavra falada por meio de anjos se mostrou firme, e toda transgressão e desobediência recebeu justa retribuição, \v 3 como escaparemos nós, tendo negligenciado tão grande salvação, a qual, tendo começado a ser falada por meio do Senhor, nos foi confirmada pelos que ouviram, \v 4 dando Deus testemunho juntamente [com eles] por sinais e prodígios e vários poderes e distribuições do Espírito Santo segundo a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} vontade?
pt.B: Pois, se a palavra anunciada por meio de anjos permaneceu válida, e toda violação dela e toda recusa em ouvi-la recebeu o castigo merecido, \v 3 como escaparemos nós, se não dermos atenção a uma salvação tão grande? O Senhor foi o primeiro a anunciá-la, e ela nos foi confirmada pelos que {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} ouviram, \v 4 enquanto Deus acrescentava o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} próprio testemunho com sinais e prodígios, com obras poderosas de muitos tipos e com a distribuição do Espírito Santo conforme {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} quis.
pt.R: Deus deu a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} Lei por meio de anjos, e essa mensagem permaneceu firme. Todos os que quebraram a Lei ou se recusaram a obedecer a ela foram castigados como mereciam. \v 3 Então, como vamos escapar se não dermos importância a uma salvação tão grande? O Senhor Jesus foi o primeiro a falar dessa salvação. Depois, as pessoas que {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} ouviram nos contaram sobre ela e nos mostraram que ela é verdadeira. \v 4 Deus também mostrou que ela é verdadeira. Ele fez sinais e maravilhas e todo tipo de milagres. E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} deu dons do Espírito Santo às pessoas, assim como {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} quis.

am.L: በመላእክት በኩል የተነገረው ቃል የጸና ከሆነ፣ መተላለፍና አለመታዘዝም ሁሉ ተገቢውን ብድራት ከተቀበለ፣ \v 3 እኛ ይህን የሚያህል ታላቅ መዳን ቸል ብለን እንዴት እናመልጣለን? ይህም መዳን በጌታ በኩል መነገር ጀምሮ በሰሙት ለእኛ ተረጋገጠ፤ \v 4 እግዚአብሔርም በምልክቶችና በድንቆች፣ በልዩ ልዩ ኃይላትም፣ እንደ ፈቃዱም በሚታደሉ የመንፈስ ቅዱስ ስጦታዎች ከእነርሱ ጋር ይመሰክር ነበር።
am.B: በመላእክት በኩል የተነገረው ቃል የጸና ከሆነ፣ እርሱንም የጣሰና ለመስማት እምቢ ያለ ሁሉ የሚገባውን ቅጣት ከተቀበለ፣ \v 3 እኛ ይህን የሚያህል ታላቅ መዳን ቸል ብንል እንዴት እናመልጣለን? ስለዚህ መዳን በመጀመሪያ የተናገረው ጌታ ነው፤ እርሱን የሰሙትም ለእኛ አረጋገጡልን፤ \v 4 እግዚአብሔርም በምልክቶችና በድንቆች፣ በልዩ ልዩ ተአምራት፣ እንደ ፈቃዱም መንፈስ ቅዱስን በማደል ምስክርነቱን ጨመረ።
am.R: እግዚአብሔር ሕጉን በመላእክት በኩል ሰጠ፤ ያም መልእክት ጸንቶ ቆመ። ሕጉን የጣሰና ለመታዘዝ እምቢ ያለ ሁሉ የሚገባውን ቅጣት ተቀበለ። \v 3 ታዲያ እንዲህ ያለውን ታላቅ መዳን ቸል ብንል እንዴት እናመልጣለን? ስለዚህ መዳን በመጀመሪያ የተናገረው ጌታ ኢየሱስ ነው። ከዚያም እርሱን የሰሙት ሰዎች ለእኛ ነገሩን፤ እውነት መሆኑንም አሳዩን። \v 4 እግዚአብሔርም እውነት መሆኑን አሳየ። ምልክቶችንና ድንቆችን፣ ብዙ ዓይነት ተአምራትንም አደረገ። እንደ ፈቃዱም የመንፈስ ቅዱስን ስጦታዎች ለሰዎች ሰጠ።

decisions.choice: the word spoken through angels: the law given at Sinai
decisions.reason: Jewish tradition held that angels were present at the giving of the law (Deuteronomy 33:2 in the Greek; compare Acts 7:38, 53; Galatians 3:19). The author argues from this: if the law brought by angels was binding, the message brought by the Son is more so.

decisions.choice: firm: valid and binding, in force
decisions.reason: βέβαιος was a legal word for what is valid and guaranteed. The verb from the same family appears in verse 3 ("confirmed"): the new message too was made sure.

decisions.choice: transgression and disobedience: stepping over the line, and refusing to listen
decisions.reason: παράβασις is crossing a boundary, breaking a command. παρακοή is literally "hearing amiss", a refusal to listen and obey, which links to the call to pay attention in verse 1.

decisions.choice: argument from the lesser to the greater
decisions.reason: "If ... how?" argues from the lesser to the greater: if breaking the law brought sure punishment, neglecting a greater salvation will not go unpunished. Hebrews uses the same pattern in 10:28-29 and 12:25.

decisions.choice: neglected: treated carelessly, paid no attention to
decisions.reason: ἀμελέω means "be unconcerned about, disregard". It is the opposite of the close attention of verse 1, not an open rejection.

decisions.choice: first spoken by the Lord Jesus, then confirmed by those who heard him
decisions.reason: "The Lord" is Jesus, who first announced this salvation in his ministry. The message reached the author and the readers through others who had heard him: the author counts himself with them ("to us") as one who did not hear Jesus in person.

decisions.choice: signs, wonders, and various powers: miracles that confirmed the message
decisions.reason: The three words appear together for the miracles that marked out Jesus and the apostles (Acts 2:22; 2 Corinthians 12:12). "Signs" point to a meaning, "wonders" cause amazement, and "powers" are mighty works.

decisions.choice: distributions of the Holy Spirit, given as God wills
alternatives: distributions made by the Holy Spirit according to the Spirit's will
decisions.reason: "Distributions of the Holy Spirit" may mean gifts that God gives out by the Spirit, or the Spirit himself given in portions to believers. "His will" refers to God, who is the subject of this part of the sentence. Elsewhere it is the Spirit who distributes gifts as he wills (1 Corinthians 12:11).

decisions.choice: the question ends at "as great as this?"; the rest becomes statements
decisions.reason: The Greek is one long question. Balanced ends the question once its point is made, and puts the clauses about how the message came in a new sentence.

decisions.choice: God gave {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} law through angels; the Lord Jesus
decisions.reason: Readable says outright that the word spoken through angels is God's law (m1) and that "the Lord" is Jesus (m6).

decisions.choice: was punished as they deserved
decisions.reason: Readable says "punished as they deserved" for "received a just recompense".

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} habían escuchado
decisions.reason: For a male person as direct object Spanish in Latin America uses "lo" and much of Spain uses "le". The text uses "lo", the form understood everywhere; the plural_you setting does not cover this difference.

decisions.choice: malipo yaliyostahili (L); adhabu iliyostahili (B); aliadhibiwa kama alivyostahili (R)
decisions.reason: "Haki" is kept for righteousness, a key term (1:9). Here the Greek word means a penalty that fits the offence, which "-stahili" (deserved) says without borrowing that word.

decisions.choice: miujiza (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says "miracles" for the "powers", as the English Readable does; "ishara" stays for "signs" at every level, so the two Greek words remain distinct.

decisions.choice: un juste salaire (L)
decisions.reason: The Greek noun means a paying back of wages, and "salaire" keeps that picture at Literal: what the breach of the law earned. Balanced and Readable say what it was, a penalty, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "dấu lạ" for signs, "việc phi thường" for wonders, "việc quyền năng" (L, B), "phép lạ" (R) for powers
decisions.reason: The three words name miracles that confirmed the message (m7). "Dấu lạ" is the word the style guide keeps for "sign"; "phép lạ" is kept for the mighty works at Readable, as the English Readable says "miracles".

decisions.choice: "Chúa" (L, B); "Chúa Giê-xu" (R)
decisions.reason: The Lord who first spoke of salvation is Jesus (m6); Readable names him, as the English Readable does. With "Chúa", the honorific "Đức" is not used, as in the Vietnamese Colossians.

decisions.choice: "표적" for signs; "놀라운 일" for wonders; "능력" (L), "능력 있는 일" (B), "기적" (R) for powers
decisions.reason: "표적" is the Korean Gospels' word for a sign and is never "기적" (Korean style guide, section 6); "능력 있는 일" is their word for the mighty works (Matthew 11:21). "기사" is the older church word for wonders. Readable says "기적" for the third word, as the English Readable says "miracles".

source.text: Οὐ γὰρ ἀγγέλοις ὑπέταξεν τὴν οἰκουμένην τὴν μέλλουσαν, περὶ ἧς λαλοῦμεν·

records.literal_gloss: Not for to angels did he subject the inhabited world the coming, about which we are speaking;

en.L: For not to angels did {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} subject the coming inhabited world, about which we are speaking;
en.B: For God did not place the world to come, the world we are talking about, under the rule of angels.
en.R: God did not put angels in charge of the new world that is coming. That is the world we are talking about.

es.L: Porque no a ángeles sometió el mundo habitado venidero, del cual estamos hablando;
es.B: Porque Dios no puso bajo el gobierno de los ángeles el mundo venidero, el mundo del que estamos hablando.
es.R: Dios no puso a los ángeles al mando del mundo nuevo que viene. Ese es el mundo del que estamos hablando.

fr.L: Car ce n’est pas à des anges qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a soumis le monde habité à venir, dont nous parlons ;
fr.B: Car Dieu n’a pas placé sous l’autorité des anges le monde à venir, le monde dont nous parlons.
fr.R: Dieu n’a pas confié aux anges la direction du monde nouveau qui vient. C’est de ce monde-là que nous parlons.

sw.L: Kwa maana si malaika aliowatiishia ulimwengu ujao unaokaliwa, ambao tunauzungumzia;
sw.B: Kwa maana Mungu hakuuweka ulimwengu ujao, ule tunaouzungumzia, chini ya utawala wa malaika.
sw.R: Mungu hakuwapa malaika mamlaka juu ya ulimwengu mpya unaokuja. Huo ndio ulimwengu tunaouzungumzia.

vi.L: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã không đặt thế giới có người ở sắp đến, là thế giới mà chúng ta đang nói đến, phục dưới các thiên sứ;
vi.B: Vì Đức Chúa Trời đã không đặt thế giới sắp đến, là thế giới chúng ta đang nói đến, dưới quyền cai trị của các thiên sứ.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời đã không giao cho các thiên sứ cai quản thế giới mới đang đến. Đó là thế giới mà chúng ta đang nói đến.

ko.L: [하나님께서] 우리가 말하고 있는 다가올 세상을 천사들에게 복종시키지 않으셨기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 하나님께서는 우리가 말하고 있는 다가올 세상을 천사들의 다스림 아래 두지 않으셨습니다.
ko.R: 하나님께서는 앞으로 올 새 세상을 천사들에게 맡기지 않으셨습니다. 우리가 지금 말하고 있는 것이 바로 그 세상입니다.

pt.L: Pois não foi a anjos que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} sujeitou o mundo habitado que há de vir, a respeito do qual estamos falando;
pt.B: Pois Deus não colocou sob o domínio de anjos o mundo que há de vir, o mundo de que estamos falando.
pt.R: Deus não pôs os anjos para governar o novo mundo que está para vir. É desse mundo que estamos falando.

am.L: ስለ እርሱ የምንናገረውን የሚመጣውን ዓለም ለመላእክት አላስገዛምና፤
am.B: እግዚአብሔር ስለ እርሱ የምንናገረውን የሚመጣውን ዓለም በመላእክት ሥልጣን ሥር አላደረገውምና።
am.R: እግዚአብሔር የሚመጣውን አዲሱን ዓለም ለመላእክት አላስረከበም። የምንናገረው ስለዚያ ዓለም ነው።

decisions.choice: the coming inhabited world: the new order God is bringing, already begun with the Son's enthronement
decisions.reason: οἰκουμένη is the word used in 1:6 for the world into which God brings the firstborn. "The coming world" is the new age of salvation, which believers already taste (6:5) and will fully enter (13:14, "the city to come").

decisions.choice: not to angels: the present world was thought to be under angelic powers
decisions.reason: According to Deuteronomy 32:8 in the Greek, God divided the nations "according to the number of the angels of God", and Daniel 10:13, 20 speaks of angelic princes over nations. The author may be contrasting that with the world to come, which God has subjected not to angels but to the human being of Psalm 8, fulfilled in Jesus.

decisions.choice: subject: the verb that the quotation of Psalm 8 takes up
decisions.reason: ὑποτάσσω, "put under, subject", is the verb of Psalm 8:7, quoted in verse 8 ("you subjected all things under his feet"). The author chooses it to lead into the psalm.

decisions.choice: God
decisions.reason: The Greek says only "he subjected"; the subject is God, as in chapter 1, so Balanced and Readable name him.

decisions.choice: the world (R: the new world that is coming)
decisions.reason: Literal says "inhabited world" as at 1:6; Balanced and Readable say "world".

decisions.choice: aliowatiishia (kutiisha)
decisions.reason: Literal uses "kutiisha" (to put under) because the quotation of Psalm 8 that follows uses the same verb (verse 8, "ulivitiisha"), and meaning decision m3 says the author chose this word to lead into it.

decisions.choice: "thế giới sắp đến" for "the coming inhabited world"
decisions.reason: The coming world is the new order God is bringing (m1). "Thế giới" is used, not "thế gian", which the style guide keeps for the world set against God; "sắp đến" is the word of the Vietnamese Mark for "the age to come" (10:30).

decisions.choice: "복종시키다" (L) here and in the psalm of 2:7-8; "아래 두다" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The verb is the one the quotation of Psalm 8 takes up (meaning decision), so Literal uses one Korean verb for it through 2:5-8 and the link can be traced; Balanced and Readable say "put under", as the Korean Ephesians 1:22 does. |

source.text: διεμαρτύρατο δέ πού τις λέγων· Τί ἐστιν ἄνθρωπος ὅτι μιμνῄσκῃ αὐτοῦ, ἢ υἱὸς ἀνθρώπου ὅτι ἐπισκέπτῃ αὐτόν;

records.literal_gloss: Testified but somewhere someone saying, What is man that you remember him, or son of man that you look after him?

en.L: But someone has testified somewhere, saying, "What is {{gender:a human being|man}} that {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} remember him, or [the] son of man that {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} look after him?
en.B: But there is a place where someone has testified, "What is {{gender:a human being|man}}, that {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} remember him, or {{gender:a mortal|the son of man}}, that {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} watch over him?
en.R: Somewhere in Scripture someone says this to God: "What is {{gender:a human being|man}}, that {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} should think of him? What is {{gender:a mere mortal|the son of man}}, that {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} should take care of him?

es.L: Pero alguien ha testificado en algún lugar, diciendo: «¿Qué es el {{gender:ser humano|hombre}} para que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} acuerdes de él, o [el] hijo de hombre para que lo cuides?
es.B: Pero hay un lugar donde alguien ha dado testimonio: «¿Qué es el {{gender:ser humano|hombre}}, para que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} acuerdes de él, o {{gender:un mortal|el hijo del hombre}}, para que lo cuides?
es.R: En algún lugar de las Escrituras alguien dice esto a Dios: «¿Qué es el {{gender:ser humano|hombre}}, para que pienses en él? ¿Qué es {{gender:un simple mortal|el hijo del hombre}}, para que cuides de él?

fr.L: Mais quelqu’un a rendu témoignage quelque part, en disant : « Qu’est-ce que l’{{gender:être humain|homme}} pour que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} souviennes de lui, ou [le] fils d’homme pour que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} prennes soin de lui ?
fr.B: Mais il y a un endroit où quelqu’un a rendu ce témoignage : « Qu’est-ce que l’{{gender:être humain|homme}}, pour que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} souviennes de lui, ou {{gender:un mortel|le fils de l’homme}}, pour que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} veilles sur lui ?
fr.R: Quelque part dans l’Écriture, quelqu’un dit ceci à Dieu : « Qu’est-ce que l’{{gender:être humain|homme}}, pour que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} penses à lui ? Et {{gender:un simple mortel|le fils de l’homme}}, qu’est-il, pour que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} prennes soin de lui ?

sw.L: Lakini mtu fulani mahali fulani ameshuhudia, akisema, "Mwanadamu ni nini, kwamba unamkumbuka, au mwana wa mtu, kwamba unamtunza?
sw.B: Lakini kuna mahali ambapo mtu fulani ameshuhudia, "Binadamu ni nini, kwamba unamkumbuka, au mwanadamu, kwamba unamjali?
sw.R: Mahali fulani katika Maandiko mtu fulani anamwambia Mungu hivi: "Mwanadamu ni nini mpaka umfikirie? Binadamu dhaifu ni nini mpaka umtunze?

vi.L: Nhưng có người đã làm chứng ở một chỗ kia rằng: "Con người là gì mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nhớ đến, hay con của loài người là gì mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chăm sóc?
vi.B: Nhưng có một chỗ kia, có người đã làm chứng: "Con người là gì mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nhớ đến, loài người là gì mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chăm nom?
vi.R: Ở một chỗ trong Kinh Thánh, có người đã thưa với Đức Chúa Trời: "Con người là gì mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phải nghĩ đến? Loài người chỉ là phận phàm nhân, sao {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lại chăm sóc họ?

ko.L: 그러나 누군가가 어디에선가 증언하여 말하였습니다. "사람이 무엇이기에 주님께서 그를 기억하시며, 사람의 아들이 무엇이기에 주님께서 그를 돌보십니까?
ko.B: 그러나 성경의 어떤 곳에서 누군가가 이렇게 증언하였습니다. "사람이 무엇이기에 주님께서 그를 기억하십니까? 한낱 사람이 무엇이기에 주님께서 그를 돌보십니까?

decisions.choice: someone has testified somewhere: a way of citing Scripture by its message, not its human author
decisions.reason: The author knows the source well (Psalm 8, a psalm of David), but in Hebrews what matters is that God speaks in Scripture (1:5-13; 3:7), so the human speaker can be left vague. He cites Genesis 2:2 the same way in 4:4.

decisions.choice: Psalm 8:5-7
decisions.reason: Verses 6-8 quote Psalm 8:5-7 in the wording of the Greek translation. The psalm marvels that God has given weak humankind honor and rule over his works (Genesis 1:26-28).

decisions.choice: the psalm speaks of humankind; the author reads it of Jesus in verse 9
alternatives: the author reads the whole psalm as about Jesus from the start
decisions.reason: In the psalm "man" and "son of man" are parallel ways of saying "human being": "son of man" is not here the title Jesus uses of himself in the Gospels. The psalm speaks of humankind's God-given place. In verse 8 the author observes that this rule is not yet seen, and in verse 9 he sees it fulfilled in Jesus, the one human being already crowned with glory and honor, who brings many others to glory (verse 10). Some read the psalm as about Jesus from the start of the quotation.

decisions.choice: remember, look after: God keeps the human being in mind and cares for him
decisions.reason: μιμνῄσκομαι is "remember, be mindful of". ἐπισκέπτομαι is "visit, look upon", used of God coming to help and care for his people (Luke 1:68).

decisions.choice: {{gender:a human being|man}}; {{gender:a mortal|the son of man}}
alternatives: What are human beings, that you remember them
decisions.reason: The psalm speaks of human beings in general, so the gender setting gives inclusive wording by default, with the traditional "man" and "the son of man" as the alternative. Literal keeps "son of man", lowercase, since it is the psalm's name for a human being and not a title. The pronoun "him" is kept singular, because the author goes on to apply the psalm to one man, Jesus (verse 9); it takes no deity_pronoun span, since in the psalm it is the human being.

decisions.choice: Somewhere in Scripture someone says this to God
decisions.reason: Readable says that the words are from Scripture and are spoken to God, since "you" in the psalm is God.

decisions.choice: el {{gender:ser humano|hombre}}; {{gender:un mortal|el hijo del hombre}} (B), {{gender:un simple mortal|el hijo del hombre}} (R)
decisions.reason: Unlike "hermanos", Spanish "el hombre" is often heard as a male, so here the inclusive "ser humano" is the default, as the English has it. "Él" and "lo" for the human being of the psalm stay as they are: they refer back to "ser humano", a masculine noun, and take no deity_pronoun span (see the English r-en-1 on verse 7).

decisions.choice: mwanadamu, binadamu, mwana wa mtu: no gender setting
decisions.reason: Swahili "mwanadamu", "binadamu" and "mtu" already mean a human being, man or woman, so there is nothing for the gender setting to change; the only male word, "mwanamume", would change the meaning. Literal says "mwana wa mtu", not the title "Mwana wa Adamu", because the psalm speaks of humankind (meaning decision m3) and the title would decide in advance that it speaks of Jesus.

decisions.choice: l’{{gender:être humain|homme}}; {{gender:un mortel|le fils de l’homme}} (B), {{gender:un simple mortel|le fils de l’homme}} (R)
alternatives: l’homme, le fils de l’homme (no setting)
decisions.reason: As in English, the psalm speaks of humankind, so the inclusive wording is the default and the traditional "homme" the alternative; "le fils de l’homme" here is lowercase, not the title of Jesus. Both options must read correctly after the words before them, so French avoids an elision in front of a span: Readable asks "Et un simple mortel, qu’est-il" rather than "Qu’est-ce qu’un simple mortel", which would break with the alternative. Literal keeps "fils d’homme" without a setting, as the English Literal does.

decisions.choice: "con người", "con của loài người" (L), "loài người" (B, R), with no gender span; "Ngài" for God addressed
alternatives: gender spans as in the English
decisions.reason: The psalm speaks of humankind (m3). Vietnamese "con người" and "loài người" already include women and men, so the English gender setting has nothing to change; Literal keeps "con của loài người" for "son of man", lowercase, so it is not read as the title "Con Người". The psalmist speaks to God as "Ngài", as the style guide sets for the psalms.

decisions.choice: "사람" for man, with no gender span; "사람의 아들" (L), "한낱 사람" (B), "죽을 수밖에 없는 사람" (R) for the son of man; the psalmist speaks to God in 합쇼체 with "주님"
alternatives: gender spans as in the English
decisions.reason: Korean "사람" already means a human being of either sex, so the gender setting has nothing to change. The psalm speaks of humankind (meaning decision), so the phrase is not given the title "인자" that the Gospels use for Jesus; Literal keeps the Hebrew idiom, and Balanced and Readable say what it means, as the English does. The psalmist addresses God as the style guide sets (section 7a).

decisions.choice: {{gender:o ser humano|o homem}}; {{gender:um simples mortal|o filho do homem}} (B, R); [o] filho do homem (L)
decisions.reason: As in the English. "Filho do homem" stays lowercase: in the psalm it means a human being, not the title "o Filho do Homem" of the Gospels (m3), which is never under the gender setting. "Dele" and "nele" refer back to the human being and are ordinary Portuguese with either option.

decisions.choice: ሰው; የሰው ልጅ, with no gender span
alternatives: gender spans as in the English
decisions.reason: Amharic ሰው (a person) and የሰው ልጅ (a human being) already include women and men, so the Amharic has nothing for the English gender setting to change here and in 2:10 (ልጆች, children). The psalm's "son of man" is not the title Son of Man here (meaning decision m3).

source.text: ἠλάττωσας αὐτὸν βραχύ τι παρ’ ἀγγέλους, δόξῃ καὶ τιμῇ ἐστεφάνωσας αὐτόν, πάντα ὑπέταξας ὑποκάτω τῶν ποδῶν αὐτοῦ· ἐν τῷ γὰρ ὑποτάξαι τὰ πάντα οὐδὲν ἀφῆκεν αὐτῷ ἀνυπότακτον.

records.literal_gloss: You made lower him a little some than angels, with glory and honor you crowned him, \v 8 all things you subjected under the feet of him. In the for to subject the all things nothing he left to him unsubjected.

en.L: You made him a little lower than [the] angels; with glory and honor {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} crowned him; \v 8 all things {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} subjected under his feet." For in subjecting all things [to him], {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} left nothing unsubjected to him.
en.B: You made him a little lower than the angels; with glory and honor {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} crowned him, \v 8 and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} put all things in subjection under his feet." When God subjected all things to him, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} left nothing that is not subject to him.
en.R: You made him a little lower than the angels. You gave him glory and honor like a crown. \v 8 You put everything under his feet." When God put everything under him, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} left nothing out.

es.L: Lo hiciste un poco inferior a [los] ángeles; de gloria y de honra lo coronaste; \v 8 todo lo sometiste bajo sus pies». Porque al someter[le] todas las cosas, nada dejó que no le estuviera sometido.
es.B: Lo hiciste un poco inferior a los ángeles; lo coronaste de gloria y de honra, \v 8 y pusiste todas las cosas bajo sus pies». Cuando Dios le sometió todas las cosas, no dejó nada que no le estuviera sometido.
es.R: Lo hiciste un poco inferior a los ángeles. Le diste gloria y honra como una corona. \v 8 Pusiste todo bajo sus pies». Cuando Dios le sometió todo, no dejó nada fuera.

fr.L: Tu l’as rendu un peu inférieur aux anges ; de gloire et d’honneur {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} l’as couronné ; \v 8 toutes choses {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} les as soumises sous ses pieds. » Car en [lui] soumettant toutes choses, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} n’a rien laissé qui ne lui soit soumis.
fr.B: Tu l’as placé un peu au-dessous des anges ; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} l’as couronné de gloire et d’honneur, \v 8 et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as mis toutes choses sous ses pieds. » Quand Dieu lui a soumis toutes choses, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} n’a rien laissé qui ne lui soit soumis.
fr.R: Tu l’as fait un peu inférieur aux anges. Tu lui as donné la gloire et l’honneur comme une couronne. \v 8 Tu as tout mis sous ses pieds. » Quand Dieu lui a tout soumis, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} n’a rien laissé de côté.

vi.B: Ngài đã làm cho người thấp hơn các thiên sứ một chút; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đội cho người mão vinh quang và tôn trọng, \v 8 và đã đặt muôn vật phục dưới chân người." Khi Đức Chúa Trời bắt muôn vật phục người, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không để lại điều gì mà không phục người.

ko.L: 주님께서는 그를 천사들보다 조금 낮추셨고, 영광과 존귀로 그에게 관을 씌우셨으며, \v 8 만물을 그의 발아래 복종시키셨습니다." 만물을 [그에게] 복종시키실 때에, [하나님께서는] 그에게 복종하지 않는 것을 하나도 남겨 두지 않으셨습니다.
ko.B: 주님께서는 그를 천사들보다 조금 낮게 하셨고, 영광과 존귀로 그에게 관을 씌우셨으며, \v 8 모든 것을 그의 발아래 두셨습니다." 하나님께서 모든 것을 그에게 복종시키실 때, 그에게 복종하지 않는 것은 하나도 남겨 두지 않으셨습니다.
ko.R: 주님께서는 그를 천사들보다 조금 낮게 만드셨습니다. 그에게 영광과 존귀를 면류관처럼 씌워 주셨습니다. \v 8 주님께서는 모든 것을 그의 발아래 두셨습니다." 하나님께서 모든 것을 그의 아래 두셨을 때, 하나님께서는 아무것도 빼놓지 않으셨습니다.

pt.L: Tu o fizeste um pouco menor que [os] anjos; de glória e de honra {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} o coroaste; \v 8 todas as coisas {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} sujeitaste debaixo dos pés dele." Pois, ao sujeitar todas as coisas [a ele], {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} nada deixou que não lhe estivesse sujeito.
pt.B: Tu o puseste um pouco abaixo dos anjos; de glória e de honra {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} o coroaste \v 8 e sujeitaste todas as coisas debaixo dos pés dele." Quando Deus sujeitou a ele todas as coisas, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} nada deixou que não lhe estivesse sujeito.
pt.R: Tu o puseste um pouco abaixo dos anjos. Tu lhe deste glória e honra, como uma coroa. \v 8 Tu puseste tudo debaixo dos pés dele." Quando Deus pôs tudo debaixo dele, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} não deixou nada de fora.

am.L: ከመላእክት ጥቂት አሳነስከው፤ በክብርና በሞገስ አቀዳጀኸው፤ \v 8 ሁሉን ከእግሮቹ በታች አስገዛህለት።» ሁሉን [ለእርሱ] በማስገዛቱ ያልተገዛለትን ምንም አልተወምና።
am.B: ከመላእክት ጥቂት አሳነስከው፤ በክብርና በሞገስ አቀዳጀኸው፤ \v 8 ሁሉንም ከእግሮቹ በታች አስገዛህለት።» እግዚአብሔር ሁሉን ለእርሱ ሲያስገዛ ያልተገዛለትን ምንም ነገር አልተወም።
am.R: ከመላእክት ጥቂት ዝቅ አደረግኸው። ክብርንና ሞገስን እንደ ዘውድ ሰጠኸው። \v 8 ሁሉን ከእግሮቹ በታች አደረግህለት።» እግዚአብሔር ሁሉን ከእርሱ በታች ሲያደርግ ምንም ነገር አላስቀረም።

decisions.choice: Psalm 8:6-7 (Greek), continued: "angels"
decisions.reason: The quotation of Psalm 8 continues. Where the Greek has "lower than angels", the Hebrew has "lower than God" (or "than heavenly beings"), since the Hebrew word can mean God, gods, or the beings of God's court. The author follows the Greek, which suits his comparison of the Son with the angels.

decisions.choice: the quotation omits "and you set him over the works of your hands" (SBLGNT)
alternatives: you crowned him with glory and honor, and set him over the works of your hands
decisions.reason: After "you crowned him", many manuscripts (among them Sinaiticus, Alexandrinus, Ephraemi and Bezae) add "and you set him over the works of your hands", the next line of the Greek psalm. The SBL text leaves it out, with the oldest papyrus (P46), Vaticanus and the later majority of manuscripts. The longer text may have been filled in from the psalm by copyists. This description is from general knowledge; reviewers must check it against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: a little lower: lower by a small degree, as the psalm means it
decisions.reason: βραχύ τι can mean "a little" in degree or "for a little while" in time. In the psalm it is degree: humankind is only a little below the beings of heaven. In verse 9 the author seems to use the same words of time, for Jesus' brief humbling (see the decision there).

decisions.choice: in subjecting all things, he left nothing unsubjected: the author presses the word "all"
decisions.reason: The author comments on the psalm: "all things" means everything, with nothing left out. That makes the next statement sharper: all things are not yet seen subjected to the human being (verse 8b). The subject is God, as in the psalm.

decisions.choice: him (no deity_pronoun span)
decisions.reason: In the psalm "him" is the human being, so it takes no deity_pronoun span, though verse 9 applies the psalm to Jesus. "You" is God, addressed in the psalm, and takes the span.

decisions.choice: gave him glory and honor like a crown
alternatives: crowned him with glory and honor
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture of crowning; it keeps "glory" as every level does.

decisions.choice: "người" for the human being of the psalm, with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: The English gives this "him" no setting, since the psalm speaks of humankind (m1 in 2:8). Vietnamese "người" is the ordinary respectful pronoun for a person and keeps the psalm's singular, so that verse 9 can apply it to Jesus.

decisions.choice: "조금" (a little in degree) here; "잠시" (for a little while) in 2:9
decisions.reason: The meaning decisions read the phrase in the psalm as lower by a small degree, and in the writer's own use in 2:9 as for a little while (both uncertain and footnoted); Korean has to choose a word for each, and follows them.

decisions.choice: o, dele, lhe (no deity_pronoun span)
decisions.reason: As in the English: in the psalm "o", "dele" and "lhe" are the human being, so they take no span; "tu", addressed to God, does.

decisions.choice: በክብርና በሞገስ አቀዳጀኸው (you crowned him with glory and honour)
decisions.reason: ክብር is kept for glory (doxa), the key term; ሞገስ, honour and favour, renders timē so the two words stay distinct, here and in 2:9.

source.text: νῦν δὲ οὔπω ὁρῶμεν αὐτῷ τὰ πάντα ὑποτεταγμένα·

records.literal_gloss: Now but not yet do we see to him the all things having been subjected;

en.L: But now we do not yet see all things subjected to him;
en.B: But as it is, we do not yet see all things put under him.

fr.L: Mais maintenant nous ne voyons pas encore que toutes choses lui sont soumises ;
fr.B: Mais pour l’instant, nous ne voyons pas encore que tout lui est soumis.
fr.R: Mais nous ne voyons pas encore que tout est soumis aux êtres humains.

decisions.choice: him: the human being of the psalm, that is, humankind
alternatives: Jesus, whose enemies are not yet all subjected
decisions.reason: The author has just applied "all things" strictly. Now he observes that humankind does not yet rule over everything as the psalm says. Then he turns to the one in whom the psalm is already fulfilled: "but we see Jesus" (verse 9). Some take "him" here already as Jesus, whose rule is not yet complete (compare 10:13).

decisions.choice: but now, not yet: the present contrasted with what God has promised
decisions.reason: "Now ... not yet" sets the present state of the world against the psalm's promise. The fulfillment has begun in Jesus but is not complete.

decisions.choice: human beings
decisions.reason: Readable says "human beings" for "him", following meaning decision m1, so that a young reader can follow the argument. Literal and Balanced keep "him".

source.text: τὸν δὲ βραχύ τι παρ’ ἀγγέλους ἠλαττωμένον βλέπομεν Ἰησοῦν διὰ τὸ πάθημα τοῦ θανάτου δόξῃ καὶ τιμῇ ἐστεφανωμένον, ὅπως χωρὶς θεοῦ ὑπὲρ παντὸς γεύσηται θανάτου.

records.literal_gloss: The [one] but for a little some than angels having been made lower we see, Jesus, because of the suffering of the death with glory and honor having been crowned, so that apart from God for everyone he might taste death.

en.L: But we see the one made lower than [the] angels for a little [while], Jesus, crowned with glory and honor because of the suffering of death, so that apart from God {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} might taste death for everyone.
en.B: But Jesus we do see. For a little while {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was placed lower than the angels, and because of the death {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} suffered {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has been crowned with glory and honor, so that apart from God {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} should taste death on behalf of everyone.
en.R: But we do see Jesus. For a short time God made {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} lower than the angels. Jesus suffered death, and because of that God has crowned {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} with glory and honor. So, apart from God, Jesus went through death for everyone.

es.L: Pero vemos al que por un poco [de tiempo] fue hecho inferior a [los] ángeles, a Jesús, coronado de gloria y de honra a causa del padecimiento de la muerte, para que aparte de Dios gustara la muerte por todos.
es.B: Pero a Jesús sí {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} vemos. Por un poco de tiempo fue puesto en un lugar inferior a los ángeles, y a causa de la muerte que sufrió ha sido coronado de gloria y de honra, para que, aparte de Dios, gustara la muerte a favor de todos.
es.R: Pero sí vemos a Jesús. Por un tiempo corto Dios {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} puso por debajo de los ángeles. Jesús sufrió la muerte, y por eso Dios {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} ha coronado de gloria y de honra. Así, aparte de Dios, Jesús pasó por la muerte a favor de todos.

fr.L: Mais nous voyons celui qui pour un peu [de temps] a été rendu inférieur aux anges, Jésus, couronné de gloire et d’honneur à cause de la souffrance de la mort, afin que, sans Dieu, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} goûte la mort pour tous.
fr.B: Mais Jésus, nous {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} voyons. Pour un peu de temps {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a été placé plus bas que les anges, et à cause de la mort qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a soufferte, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a été couronné de gloire et d’honneur, afin que, sans Dieu, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} goûte la mort en faveur de tous.
fr.R: Mais nous voyons bien Jésus. Pour un peu de temps, Dieu {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a mis plus bas que les anges. Jésus a subi la mort, et à cause de cela Dieu {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a couronné de gloire et d’honneur. Ainsi, sans Dieu, Jésus a traversé la mort pour tous.
