vi.L: Nhưng chúng ta thấy Đấng đã bị làm cho thấp hơn các thiên sứ một thời gian ngắn, là Đức Giê-xu, được đội mão vinh quang và tôn trọng vì sự chịu chết, để ngoài Đức Chúa Trời, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nếm sự chết vì mọi người.
vi.B: Nhưng chúng ta thấy Đức Giê-xu. Trong một thời gian ngắn, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã bị đặt thấp hơn các thiên sứ, và vì sự chết {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã chịu, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nay được đội mão vinh quang và tôn trọng, để ngoài Đức Chúa Trời, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nếm sự chết thay cho mọi người.
vi.R: Nhưng chúng ta thấy Đức Giê-xu. Trong một thời gian ngắn, Đức Chúa Trời đã làm cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thấp hơn các thiên sứ. Đức Giê-xu đã chịu chết, và vì vậy Đức Chúa Trời đã đội cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mão vinh quang và tôn trọng. Như thế, ngoài Đức Chúa Trời, Đức Giê-xu đã trải qua sự chết vì mọi người.

ko.L: 그러나 우리는 잠시 동안 천사들보다 낮아지셨던 분, 곧 예수께서 죽음의 고난 때문에 영광과 존귀의 관을 쓰신 것을 봅니다. 이는 그분이 하나님과 떨어져 모든 사람을 위하여 죽음을 맛보시게 하려는 것이었습니다.
ko.B: 그러나 우리는 예수를 봅니다. 그분은 잠시 동안 천사들보다 낮아지셨지만, 죽음의 고난을 받으셨기 때문에 영광과 존귀의 관을 쓰셨습니다. 이는 그분이 하나님과 떨어져 모든 사람을 위하여 죽음을 맛보시게 하려는 것이었습니다.
ko.R: 그러나 우리는 예수를 봅니다. 하나님께서는 잠시 동안 그분을 천사들보다 낮게 하셨습니다. 예수께서는 죽음의 고난을 받으셨고, 그 때문에 하나님께서 그분께 영광과 존귀의 관을 씌워 주셨습니다. 이렇게 예수께서는 하나님과 떨어져 모든 사람을 위하여 죽음을 겪으셨습니다.

pt.L: Mas vemos aquele que por um pouco [de tempo] foi feito menor que [os] anjos, Jesus, coroado de glória e de honra por causa do sofrimento da morte, para que, à parte de Deus, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} provasse a morte por todos.
pt.B: Mas vemos Jesus. Por um pouco de tempo {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} foi posto abaixo dos anjos e, por causa da morte que sofreu, foi coroado de glória e de honra, para que, separado de Deus, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} provasse a morte em favor de todos.
pt.R: Mas nós vemos Jesus. Por um pouco de tempo Deus {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} pôs abaixo dos anjos. Jesus sofreu a morte, e por causa disso Deus {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} coroou de glória e de honra. Assim, separado de Deus, Jesus passou pela morte por todos.

am.L: ነገር ግን ለጥቂት ጊዜ ከመላእክት ያነሰውን፣ ኢየሱስን፣ ስለ ሞት መከራ በክብርና በሞገስ ተቀዳጅቶ እናየዋለን፤ ይህም ከእግዚአብሔር ተለይቶ ስለ ሁሉ ሞትን ይቀምስ ዘንድ ነው።
am.B: ኢየሱስን ግን እናየዋለን። እርሱ ለጥቂት ጊዜ ከመላእክት አንሶ ነበር፤ በተቀበለው የሞት መከራም ምክንያት በክብርና በሞገስ ተቀዳጅቷል፤ ይኸውም ከእግዚአብሔር ተለይቶ ስለ ሰው ሁሉ ሞትን እንዲቀምስ ነው።
am.R: ኢየሱስን ግን እናየዋለን። እግዚአብሔር ለአጭር ጊዜ ከመላእክት ዝቅ አደረገው። ኢየሱስ ሞትን ተቀበለ፤ በዚህም ምክንያት እግዚአብሔር ክብርንና ሞገስን አቀዳጀው። ስለዚህ ኢየሱስ ከእግዚአብሔር ተለይቶ ስለ ሰው ሁሉ በሞት ውስጥ አለፈ።

decisions.choice: apart from God (SBLGNT), not "by the grace of God"
decisions.reason: Almost all manuscripts, including the oldest (P46, Sinaiticus, Alexandrinus, Vaticanus), read "by the grace of God". The SBL text instead reads "apart from God", found in very few manuscripts but known to several writers of the early centuries, among them Origen, who knew both readings. It is the harder reading: a copyist could easily have changed the startling "apart from God" into the familiar "by the grace of God" (the two Greek words look alike), but hardly the reverse. The SBL text governs here; the footnote gives the other reading. This description is from general knowledge; reviewers must check it against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: apart from God: Jesus went through death fully, without God sparing him
alternatives: for everyone except God (for all things but God)
decisions.reason: If "apart from God" is the right text, it most likely means that Jesus tasted death for everyone fully, as one left without God's help (compare 5:7 and Psalm 22:2, the psalm that verse 12 quotes). Others take it with "everyone": he died for everything except God himself, since God is not among the "all things" subjected (verse 8; compare 1 Corinthians 15:27). Either way it does not say that the Son was cut off from God in his being.

decisions.choice: for a little while
decisions.reason: The words of the psalm (verse 7) are taken up again. Here, set between suffering and crowning, they most naturally speak of time: Jesus was lower than the angels for a short while, in his earthly life and death, and is now crowned. The phrase can also mean "a little" in degree, as in the psalm.

decisions.choice: Jesus named for the first time; the purpose of the whole humbling
decisions.reason: The author names Jesus for the first time in the letter, holding the name back to the end of the phrase for emphasis. The "so that" clause gives the purpose of the whole sequence: he was made lower and suffered death, and so was crowned, in order that his death might be for everyone.

decisions.choice: taste death: experience death in full
decisions.reason: "Taste death" is a Jewish idiom for actually dying (Mark 9:1; John 8:52). It does not mean a mere sip of death.

decisions.choice: for everyone: on behalf of every person
decisions.reason: παντὸς could be masculine ("everyone") or neuter ("everything"). The following verses speak of people: many sons, brothers and sisters, children (verses 10-14). ὑπέρ means "on behalf of, for the sake of".

decisions.choice: God made {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}
decisions.reason: Readable names God as the one who made Jesus lower, as the psalm says ("you made him", verse 7), and says "went through death" for "taste death".

decisions.choice: mbali na Mungu (apart from God)
decisions.reason: "Bila Mungu" can sound like "godless" or "without God's help". "Mbali na Mungu" says that Jesus went through death fully, apart from God, which is how meaning decision m2 reads the SBL text.

decisions.choice: sans Dieu
decisions.reason: "Sans Dieu" says what the Greek preposition says and keeps the reading of the meaning decision: Jesus went through death fully, without God sparing him. "Séparé de Dieu" would add a claim the text does not make, and "à part Dieu" would suggest "everyone except God". The risk is that "sans Dieu" can mean "godless"; a native reviewer should judge whether readers will take it so.

decisions.choice: "ngoài Đức Chúa Trời" at every level
alternatives: "bởi ân điển của Đức Chúa Trời"
decisions.reason: The SBLGNT reads "apart from God", not "by the grace of God" (m1): Jesus went through death fully, without God sparing him (m2). "Ngoài Đức Chúa Trời" keeps the Greek phrase without settling more than the meaning decision does.

decisions.choice: "nếm sự chết" (L, B); "trải qua sự chết" (R)
decisions.reason: To taste death is to go through it in full (m5); Literal and Balanced keep the picture, Readable says it plainly.

decisions.choice: "하나님과 떨어져" for "apart from God", at every level
alternatives: "하나님의 은혜로" (the other reading of the manuscripts)
decisions.reason: The meaning decisions follow the SBLGNT reading "apart from God" and read it as Jesus going through death fully, without God sparing him; both are uncertain and footnoted, and the footnote gives "by the grace of God". "떨어져" says separation without suggesting that Jesus acted against God.

decisions.choice: à parte de Deus (L); separado de Deus (B, R)
decisions.reason: The SBL reading "apart from God" (m1). "Sem Deus" could sound as if Jesus were godless; "separado de Deus" says that he went through death without God sparing him (m2).

source.text: Ἔπρεπεν γὰρ αὐτῷ, δι’ ὃν τὰ πάντα καὶ δι’ οὗ τὰ πάντα, πολλοὺς υἱοὺς εἰς δόξαν ἀγαγόντα τὸν ἀρχηγὸν τῆς σωτηρίας αὐτῶν διὰ παθημάτων τελειῶσαι.

records.literal_gloss: It was fitting for to him, for whom the all things and through whom the all things, many sons to glory having brought, the pioneer of the salvation of them through sufferings to make perfect.

en.L: For it was fitting for {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, for whom [are] all things and through whom [are] all things, in bringing many {{gender:children|sons}} to glory, to make the pioneer of their salvation perfect through sufferings.
en.B: For God, for whose sake everything exists and through whom everything exists, was bringing many {{gender:children|sons}} to glory, and so it was right for {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to bring to perfection through sufferings the pioneer who leads them to salvation.
en.R: God made everything, and everything exists for {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. He is bringing many {{gender:children|sons}} to share in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glory. So it was right for God to make Jesus complete by letting {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} suffer. Jesus is the pioneer who leads them to salvation.

es.L: Porque convenía a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, por causa de quien [son] todas las cosas y por medio de quien [son] todas las cosas, al llevar a muchos hijos a la gloria, hacer perfecto por medio de sufrimientos al pionero de la salvación de ellos.
es.B: Porque Dios, por cuya causa existe todo y por medio de quien existe todo, estaba llevando a muchos hijos a la gloria, y por eso {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} convenía hacer perfecto por medio de sufrimientos al pionero que los guía a la salvación.
es.R: Dios hizo todas las cosas, y todo existe para {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. Está llevando a muchos hijos a compartir {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gloria. Por eso era justo que Dios hiciera completo a Jesús permitiendo que sufriera. Jesús es el pionero que va delante y los guía a la salvación.

fr.L: Car il {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} convenait, {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} pour qui [sont] toutes choses et par qui [sont] toutes choses, en conduisant de nombreux {{gender:enfants|fils}} à la gloire, de rendre parfait par des souffrances le pionnier de leur salut.
fr.B: Car Dieu, pour qui tout existe et par qui tout existe, conduisait de nombreux {{gender:enfants|fils}} à la gloire ; aussi convenait-il qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} rende parfait par des souffrances le pionnier qui les mène au salut.
fr.R: Dieu a fait toutes choses, et tout existe pour {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Il conduit de nombreux {{gender:enfants|fils}} à partager {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} gloire. Il était donc juste que Dieu rende Jésus complet en {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} laissant souffrir. Jésus est celui qui ouvre la route et les conduit au salut.

sw.L: Kwa maana ilimfaa {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}, ambaye kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} [vipo] vitu vyote na kupitia {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}} [vipo] vitu vyote, katika kuwaleta wana wengi kwenye utukufu, kumkamilisha kupitia mateso yule kiongozi wa wokovu wao.
sw.B: Kwa maana Mungu, ambaye kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kila kitu kipo na kupitia {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}} kila kitu kipo, alikuwa akiwaleta wana wengi kwenye utukufu. Kwa hiyo ilimfaa {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} kumkamilisha kupitia mateso kiongozi anayewaongoza kwenye wokovu.
sw.R: Mungu aliumba kila kitu, na kila kitu kipo kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. Anawaleta wana wengi washiriki utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. Kwa hiyo ilikuwa sawa Mungu amkamilishe Yesu kwa kumwacha ateseke. Yesu ndiye anayewatangulia na kuwaongoza kwenye wokovu.

vi.L: Vì thật xứng hợp cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, là Đấng mà muôn vật [hiện có] vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và bởi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, khi đưa nhiều con cái đến vinh quang, thì làm cho Đấng tiên phong của sự cứu rỗi họ được trọn vẹn qua những sự đau khổ.
vi.B: Vì Đức Chúa Trời, là Đấng mà muôn vật hiện có là vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và bởi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, đang đưa nhiều con cái đến vinh quang, nên thật xứng hợp khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} dùng những sự đau khổ để làm cho Đấng tiên phong, là Đấng dẫn họ đến sự cứu rỗi, được trọn vẹn.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời đã dựng nên muôn vật, và muôn vật hiện có là vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Ngài đang đưa nhiều con cái đến dự phần vinh quang của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Vì vậy, thật đúng là Đức Chúa Trời đã để Đức Giê-xu chịu khổ để làm cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} được hoàn toàn. Đức Giê-xu là Đấng tiên phong dẫn họ đến sự cứu rỗi.

ko.L: 만물이 그분을 위하여 있고 만물이 그분을 통하여 있는 그분께서, 많은 {{gender:자녀|아들}}들을 영광으로 이끌어 들이시면서, 그들의 구원의 선구자를 고난을 통하여 완전하게 하시는 것은 그분께 합당한 일이었습니다.
ko.B: 하나님께서는 만물이 그분을 위하여 있고 만물이 그분을 통하여 있는 분이십니다. 그분은 많은 {{gender:자녀|아들}}들을 영광으로 이끌고 계셨으므로, 그들을 구원으로 이끄시는 선구자를 고난을 통하여 완전하게 하시는 것이 마땅하였습니다.
ko.R: 하나님께서는 모든 것을 지으셨고, 모든 것이 그분을 위하여 있습니다. 하나님께서는 많은 {{gender:자녀|아들}}들을 이끌어 그분의 영광을 함께 누리게 하고 계십니다. 그래서 예수께서 고난을 받게 하셔서 그분을 온전하게 하시는 것은 하나님께 옳은 일이었습니다. 예수께서는 그들을 앞장서서 구원으로 이끄시는 분이십니다.

pt.L: Pois convinha a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}, por causa de quem [existem] todas as coisas e por meio de quem [existem] todas as coisas, ao conduzir muitos filhos à glória, aperfeiçoar por meio de sofrimentos o pioneiro da salvação deles.
pt.B: Pois Deus, por causa de quem tudo existe e por meio de quem tudo existe, estava conduzindo muitos filhos à glória, e por isso convinha que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} levasse à perfeição, por meio de sofrimentos, o pioneiro que os leva à salvação.
pt.R: Deus fez todas as coisas, e tudo existe para {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}. Ele está levando muitos filhos a participar da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} glória. Por isso foi certo Deus deixar Jesus sofrer, para torná-{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} completo. Jesus é o pioneiro que os leva à salvação.

am.L: ሁሉ ስለ እርሱና ሁሉ በእርሱ ለሆነለት፣ ብዙ ልጆችን ወደ ክብር ሲያመጣ፣ የመዳናቸውን ቀዳሚ መሪ በመከራዎች በኩል ፍጹም ሊያደርገው ይገባው ነበርና።
am.B: ሁሉ ስለ እርሱ የሚኖርና ሁሉ በእርሱ የሆነ እግዚአብሔር ብዙ ልጆችን ወደ ክብር ያመጣ ነበር፤ ስለዚህ ወደ መዳን የሚመራቸውን ቀዳሚ መሪ በመከራዎች በኩል ፍጹም ማድረጉ ተገቢው ነበር።
am.R: እግዚአብሔር ሁሉን ፈጠረ፤ ሁሉም ለእርሱ ይኖራል። እርሱ ብዙ ልጆችን የክብሩ ተካፋዮች እንዲሆኑ ያመጣቸዋል። ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር ኢየሱስን መከራ እንዲቀበል በማድረግ ፍጹም ብቁ ማድረጉ ተገቢ ነበር። ኢየሱስ ወደ መዳን የሚመራቸው ቀዳሚ መሪ ነው።

decisions.choice: for him, for whom and through whom all things: God, the goal and the source of everything
decisions.reason: "Him" is God. Everything exists for him as its goal and through him as its maker (compare Romans 11:36). It was fitting for such a God, who is bringing his creation to its purpose, to act in this way.

decisions.choice: in bringing: God is the one who brings many to glory
alternatives: the pioneer, who brings many sons to glory
decisions.reason: ἀγαγόντα is accusative, while "for him" is dative. It most likely refers to God, the subject of the infinitive "to make perfect": God, in bringing many to glory, perfected their pioneer. It could instead agree with "the pioneer", who brings many to glory, but then the participle would stand oddly before the noun it describes.

decisions.choice: many sons: all believers, women and men, who share the Son's place in God's family
decisions.reason: υἱός here includes every believer, daughters as well as sons (2 Corinthians 6:18). The word links them with "the Son" of chapter 1: those he saves become God's children with him (2:11-13; 12:5-8).

decisions.choice: pioneer: the leader who goes first and opens the way for others to follow
decisions.reason: ἀρχηγός can mean leader, founder, or originator: one who begins something and leads others into it. Jesus goes ahead through suffering into glory and brings his people after him. The word returns in 12:2, of Jesus as pioneer and perfecter of faith.

decisions.choice: make perfect: bring to the goal, make fully fit for his office as Savior and high priest
decisions.reason: τελειόω means "complete, bring to the goal, make fully what one is meant to be". Jesus was never imperfect in a moral sense; he was without sin (4:15; 7:26). Through suffering he was made fully fit for his calling: having learned obedience by what he suffered, he became the source of salvation and a high priest for ever (5:8-10; 7:28). In the Greek Old Testament the same verb is used for the consecration of priests to their office (Exodus 29:9, 29:33; Leviticus 16:32). The word family runs through Hebrews: the law made nothing perfect (7:19), but Christ has perfected those who are made holy (10:14). Later chapters refer back to this decision.

decisions.choice: to glory: to share in the glory with which Jesus has been crowned
decisions.reason: The glory is the honor God gives, which Jesus already has (verse 9) and into which he leads the many. It is the fulfillment of Psalm 8, where God crowns humankind with glory and honor.

decisions.choice: {{gender:children|sons}}
decisions.reason: The many brought to glory are women and men, so the gender setting gives "children" by default, with "sons" as the traditional alternative. The alternative keeps the link with "the Son"; meaning decision m3 explains it.

decisions.choice: make complete
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep "perfect" so that the word family can be followed through the letter. Readable says "make complete", because "perfect" suggests to most readers that Jesus once had faults; meaning decision m5 explains the sense.

decisions.choice: share in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glory; Jesus
decisions.reason: Readable names Jesus as the pioneer and says that the many share in God's glory (m6).

decisions.choice: pioneer
decisions.reason: "Pioneer" says both that Jesus goes first and that he opens the way for others (m4). Balanced adds "who leads them" to make the second point clear.

decisions.choice: hijos, no gender setting
decisions.reason: The English offers "children" with "sons" as the traditional form. Spanish "hijos" already covers sons and daughters and keeps the heir's standing the meaning decision (m3) describes, so, as in Ephesians 1:5, no setting is needed.

decisions.choice: pionero (for the whole letter, also 12:2)
decisions.reason: "Autor" now suggests a writer or one who causes something, and "capitán" a military rank. "Pionero" is the one who goes ahead and opens the way for others to follow (m4). Readable adds "que va delante" so the picture is plain.

decisions.choice: wana, no gender setting (for the whole letter)
decisions.reason: "Wana" (children of a parent, sons and daughters) already includes women, so the Swahili has no gender span where the English has {{gender:children|sons}}. It keeps the link with "Mwana", the Son, which meaning decision m3 draws on. The same holds in 12:5-8.

decisions.choice: kiongozi (L, B); anayewatangulia na kuwaongoza (R) (for the whole letter, also 12:2)
decisions.reason: "Kiongozi" is a leader; Balanced adds "anayewaongoza" (who leads them) and Readable uses verbs, "goes ahead of them and leads them", to bring out the sense of one who goes first and opens the way (meaning decision m4). "Mwanzilishi" (founder) would lose the picture of going ahead.

decisions.choice: de nombreux {{gender:enfants|fils}} (for the whole letter, wherever the English has the span)
decisions.reason: Like the English, French puts "fils" under the gender setting with "enfants" as the default, since the many sons are all believers, women and men (meaning decision m3). "De nombreux" is used rather than "beaucoup de", which would have to elide before "enfants" but not before "fils", so that both options read correctly. The same span is used in 12:5-8 where the English has it.

decisions.choice: pionnier (L, B); celui qui ouvre la route (R) (for the whole letter, also 12:2)
decisions.reason: The word means the leader who goes first and opens the way for others (meaning decision m4). "Pionnier" says both the going first and the opening of a way; "auteur" or "chef" each keep only one side. Readable says it with a verb. The same rendering is used in 12:2.

decisions.choice: "con cái" for "sons", with no gender span
decisions.reason: The sons are all believers, women and men (m3). Vietnamese "con cái" (children) already includes both and keeps the picture of a family, so the English gender setting has nothing to change.

decisions.choice: "Đấng tiên phong" for the pioneer at every level, with "dẫn họ đến" (B, R); also in 12:2
decisions.reason: The pioneer is the leader who goes first and opens the way for others (m4). "Tiên phong" is one who goes ahead of the others; "Đấng" marks him as Christ.

decisions.choice: "làm cho ... được trọn vẹn" (L, B); "được hoàn toàn" (R), for "make perfect" through the letter
decisions.reason: To make perfect here is to bring to the goal, to make fully fit for his office (m5), not to remove a fault. "Trọn vẹn" says complete, as in the Vietnamese James (1:4) and 1 John; "hoàn hảo" would suggest that something had been wrong with him. Readable says "hoàn toàn", as the English Readable says "complete".

decisions.choice: {{gender:자녀|아들}}들 for the many sons
decisions.reason: The many sons are all believers, women and men (meaning decision); "자녀" (children) is the inclusive default and "아들" the traditional form, as in the Korean Romans 9:4 and Galatians 4. The plural "들" stays outside the span.

decisions.choice: "선구자" (L, B), "앞장서서 이끄시는 분" (R) for the pioneer; "완전하게 하다" (L, B), "온전하게 하다" (R) for make perfect, through the letter
decisions.reason: The pioneer is the leader who goes first and opens the way (meaning decision); "선구자" says one who goes ahead of others, where "창시자" (founder) says only that he began something. Making perfect is bringing to the goal, making fully fit for his office (meaning decision, footnoted); the same verb returns in 5:9, 7:28, 10:14 and 12:23, so each level keeps one word for it.

decisions.choice: filhos, with no gender setting
decisions.reason: The English needs the setting to choose between "children" and "sons". Portuguese "filhos" already means sons and daughters and keeps the link with "o Filho" (m3), so no setting is needed, as in Matthew 5:9.

decisions.choice: o pioneiro
decisions.reason: For the whole book (also 12:2). "Pioneiro" says both that Jesus goes first and that he opens the way for those who follow (m4); "autor" says only that he began it. Readable keeps it, with the explanation "que os leva".

decisions.choice: ፍጹም ማድረግ (to make perfect); ፍጽምና (perfection) through Hebrews
decisions.reason: Hebrews' word for bringing someone to the goal is ፍጹም at every level, so the theme can be followed through the letter (2:10; 5:9; 7:19, 28; 9:9). Readable adds ብቁ (fit) to say in what sense Jesus was made perfect, as the English Readable says "complete".

decisions.choice: ቀዳሚ መሪ (the leader who goes first)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision describes the leader who goes ahead and opens the way; ቀዳሚ መሪ says both that he leads and that he goes first.

source.text: ὅ τε γὰρ ἁγιάζων καὶ οἱ ἁγιαζόμενοι ἐξ ἑνὸς πάντες· δι’ ἣν αἰτίαν οὐκ ἐπαισχύνεται ἀδελφοὺς αὐτοὺς καλεῖν, λέγων· Ἀπαγγελῶ τὸ ὄνομά σου τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς μου, ἐν μέσῳ ἐκκλησίας ὑμνήσω σε·

records.literal_gloss: The [one] both for sanctifying and those being sanctified of one all; for which reason not he is ashamed brothers them to call, \v 12 saying, I will announce the name of you to the brothers of me, in [the] midst of [the] assembly I will sing hymns to you;

en.L: For both the one sanctifying and those being sanctified [are] all from one; for which reason {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is not ashamed to call them {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, \v 12 saying, "I will announce {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name to {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}; in [the] midst of [the] assembly I will sing hymns to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}."
en.B: For the one who makes holy and those who are being made holy all come from one source. That is why {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is not ashamed to call them {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}. \v 12 He says, "I will make {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name known to {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}; in the middle of the assembly I will sing {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} praise."
en.R: Jesus makes people holy. He and the people {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} makes holy all come from the same Father. That is why Jesus is not ashamed to call them {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}. \v 12 He says to God, "I will tell {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}} who {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are. I will sing praises to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} in the middle of the gathered people."

es.L: Porque tanto el que santifica como los que son santificados [son] todos de uno; por esa causa no se avergüenza de llamarlos hermanos, \v 12 diciendo: «Anunciaré {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre a {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} hermanos; en medio de [la] asamblea {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} cantaré himnos».
es.B: Porque el que santifica y los que son santificados proceden todos de un mismo origen. Por eso no se avergüenza de llamarlos hermanos. \v 12 Dice: «Daré a conocer {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre a {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} hermanos; en medio de la asamblea cantaré {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} alabanzas».
es.R: Jesús hace santos a otros. Él y los que hace santos vienen todos del mismo Padre. Por eso Jesús no se avergüenza de llamarlos {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} hermanos. \v 12 Dice a Dios: «Les diré a {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} hermanos quién eres {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}. Te cantaré alabanzas en medio del pueblo reunido».

fr.L: Car celui qui sanctifie et ceux qui sont sanctifiés [sont] tous d’un seul ; c’est pour cette raison qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} n’a pas honte de les appeler {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, \v 12 en disant : « J’annoncerai {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom à {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}} ; au milieu de [l’]assemblée je {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} chanterai des hymnes. »
fr.B: Car celui qui sanctifie et ceux qui sont sanctifiés ont tous une même origine. C’est pourquoi {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} n’a pas honte de leur donner le nom de {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}. \v 12 Il dit : « Je ferai connaître {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom à {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}} ; au milieu de l’assemblée je chanterai {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} louange. »
fr.R: Jésus rend les gens saints. Lui et ceux qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} rend saints viennent tous du même Père. C’est pourquoi Jésus n’a pas honte de les appeler {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}. \v 12 Il dit à Dieu : « Je dirai à {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}} qui {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es. Je chanterai {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} louanges au milieu du peuple rassemblé. »

sw.L: Kwa maana yule anayetakasa na wale wanaotakaswa wote ni wa mmoja; ndiyo sababu haoni aibu kuwaita ndugu, \v 12 akisema, "Nitawatangazia ndugu {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}; katikati ya kusanyiko nitakusifu kwa nyimbo."
sw.B: Kwa maana yule anayetakasa na wale wanaotakaswa wote wanatoka katika chanzo kimoja. Ndiyo sababu haoni aibu kuwaita ndugu. \v 12 Anasema, "Nitawajulisha ndugu {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}; katikati ya kusanyiko nitaimba sifa {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}."
sw.R: Yesu huwafanya watu kuwa watakatifu. Yeye na wale anaowafanya watakatifu wote wanatoka kwa Baba yule yule. Ndiyo sababu Yesu haoni aibu kuwaita ndugu {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}. \v 12 Anamwambia Mungu, "Nitawaeleza ndugu {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} jinsi {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ulivyo. Nitakuimbia sifa katikati ya watu waliokusanyika."

vi.L: Vì cả Đấng làm cho nên thánh lẫn những người được làm cho nên thánh đều từ một [nguồn]; vì lẽ đó {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không hổ thẹn gọi họ là {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}, \v 12 khi phán: "Con sẽ rao truyền danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} của Con; ở giữa hội chúng, Con sẽ ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}."
vi.B: Vì Đấng làm cho nên thánh và những người đang được làm cho nên thánh đều đến từ một nguồn. Vì vậy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không hổ thẹn gọi họ là {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}. \v 12 Ngài phán: "Con sẽ rao truyền danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} của Con; ở giữa hội chúng, Con sẽ ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}."
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu làm cho người ta nên thánh. Ngài và những người được Ngài làm cho nên thánh đều đến từ cùng một Cha. Vì vậy Đức Giê-xu không hổ thẹn gọi họ là {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \v 12 Ngài thưa với Đức Chúa Trời: "Con sẽ cho {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} của Con biết {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là ai. Con sẽ hát ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giữa dân sự đang nhóm lại."

ko.L: 거룩하게 하시는 분과 거룩하게 되는 사람들이 모두 한 분에게서 [났습니다]. 그러므로 그분은 그들을 {{gender:형제자매|형제}}라고 부르시기를 부끄러워하지 않으시고, \v 12 말씀하십니다. "제가 주님의 이름을 제 {{gender:형제자매|형제}}들에게 선포하고, 회중 가운데서 주님을 찬송하겠습니다."
ko.B: 거룩하게 하시는 분과 거룩하게 되는 사람들은 모두 한 근원에서 나왔습니다. 그래서 그분은 그들을 {{gender:형제자매|형제}}라고 부르시기를 부끄러워하지 않으십니다. \v 12 그분은 이렇게 말씀하십니다. "제가 주님의 이름을 제 {{gender:형제자매|형제}}들에게 알리고, 회중 가운데서 주님을 찬양하겠습니다."
ko.R: 예수께서는 사람들을 거룩하게 하십니다. 예수와 그분이 거룩하게 하시는 사람들은 모두 같은 아버지에게서 났습니다. 그래서 예수께서는 그들을 자기 {{gender:형제자매|형제}}라고 부르시기를 부끄러워하지 않으십니다. \v 12 예수께서는 하나님께 이렇게 말씀하십니다. "제가 제 {{gender:형제자매|형제}}들에게 주님이 어떤 분이신지 알리겠습니다. 모인 백성 가운데서 주님을 찬양하겠습니다."

pt.L: Pois tanto o que santifica quanto os que são santificados [são] todos de um só; por essa razão {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} não se envergonha de chamá-los {{gender:irmãos e irmãs|irmãos}}, \v 12 dizendo: "Anunciarei o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} nome aos {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} {{gender:irmãos e irmãs|irmãos}}; no meio da assembleia {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} cantarei hinos."
pt.B: Pois aquele que santifica e os que são santificados vêm todos de uma só origem. É por isso que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} não se envergonha de chamá-los {{gender:irmãos e irmãs|irmãos}}. \v 12 Ele diz: "Darei a conhecer o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} nome aos {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} {{gender:irmãos e irmãs|irmãos}}; no meio da assembleia cantarei os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} louvores."
pt.R: Jesus torna as pessoas santas. Ele e as pessoas que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} torna santas vêm todos do mesmo Pai. É por isso que Jesus não se envergonha de chamá-las de {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} {{gender:irmãos e irmãs|irmãos}}. \v 12 Ele diz a Deus: "Vou contar aos {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} {{gender:irmãos e irmãs|irmãos}} quem {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} és. Vou cantar louvores a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} no meio do povo reunido."

am.L: የሚቀድሰውም የሚቀደሱትም ሁሉ ከአንድ ናቸውና፤ በዚህ ምክንያት {{gender:ወንድሞችና እኅቶች|ወንድሞች}} ብሎ ሊጠራቸው አያፍርም፤ \v 12 እንዲህ እያለ፦ «ስምህን {{gender:ለወንድሞቼና ለእኅቶቼ|ለወንድሞቼ}} አወራለሁ፤ በጉባኤ መካከል እዘምርልሃለሁ።»
am.B: ቅዱስ የሚያደርገውም ቅዱሳን የሚደረጉትም ሁሉ ከአንድ ምንጭ ናቸውና። ስለዚህ {{gender:ወንድሞቹና እኅቶቹ|ወንድሞቹ}} ብሎ ሊጠራቸው አያፍርም። \v 12 እንዲህ ይላል፦ «ስምህን {{gender:ለወንድሞቼና ለእኅቶቼ|ለወንድሞቼ}} አስታውቃለሁ፤ በጉባኤ መካከል ምስጋናህን እዘምራለሁ።»
am.R: ኢየሱስ ሰዎችን ቅዱሳን ያደርጋቸዋል። እርሱና ቅዱሳን የሚያደርጋቸው ሰዎች ሁሉ ከአንዱ አባት የመጡ ናቸው። ስለዚህ ኢየሱስ {{gender:ወንድሞቹና እኅቶቹ|ወንድሞቹ}} ብሎ ሊጠራቸው አያፍርም። \v 12 ለእግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፦ «አንተ ማን እንደ ሆንክ {{gender:ለወንድሞቼና ለእኅቶቼ|ለወንድሞቼ}} እነግራለሁ። በተሰበሰቡት ሕዝብ መካከል ምስጋና እዘምርልሃለሁ።»

decisions.choice: sanctify: make holy, set apart for God and cleansed
decisions.reason: ἁγιάζω means to make holy: to set apart for God and make fit to come near him. Jesus does it by his own blood (10:10, 10:14; 13:12). The present tense "those being sanctified" describes believers as the people in whom this work is going on.

decisions.choice: all from one: from one Father, God
decisions.reason: "From one" is left open in the Greek. Most likely it is God, the Father of the Son and of the many sons and daughters he brings to glory (verse 10). It could also mean one ancestor (Adam, or Abraham, verse 16) or one common human nature (verse 14).

decisions.choice: brothers: the whole family of believers, women and men
decisions.reason: Jesus calls those he makes holy his brothers and sisters: they belong to one family. The word includes women, as it does when the author addresses his readers (3:1, 3:12).

decisions.choice: Psalm 22:23 (21:23 Greek)
decisions.reason: The quotation is Psalm 22:23 (21:23 in the Greek numbering). The psalm begins with the cry of a sufferer forsaken by God ("My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?", Psalm 22:2, words Jesus spoke on the cross) and turns at verse 23 to praise among God's people after God has rescued him. The author puts the words in the mouth of Jesus, who after his suffering praises God among his brothers and sisters.

decisions.choice: assembly: the gathered people of God
decisions.reason: ἐκκλησία translates the Hebrew word for Israel gathered for worship. In 12:23 the same word is used of the gathering of the firstborn in heaven.

decisions.choice: your name: who God is and what he has done
decisions.reason: In Scripture a name stands for the person and his character. To announce God's name is to tell who he is and what he has done.

decisions.choice: {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}
decisions.reason: Those Jesus calls his brothers include women, so the gender setting applies, with the traditional "brothers" as the alternative.

decisions.choice: makes holy; being made holy
decisions.reason: Literal says "sanctify". Balanced and Readable say "make holy", which says the same in plain words, as everywhere in Hebrews.

decisions.choice: from the same Father
decisions.reason: Readable follows meaning decision m2 and names the "one" as the Father. It is uncertain, as m2 says.

decisions.choice: who {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are; the gathered people
decisions.reason: Readable explains "your name" (m6) and says "the gathered people" for "the assembly".

decisions.choice: hermanos, no gender setting (for the whole letter)
decisions.reason: Spanish "hermanos" already covers brothers and sisters, so adding "y hermanas" would add words the Greek does not have; the whole family of believers is meant (m3). This follows Romans, Philippians and Colossians. A reviewer may prefer to make the women explicit.

decisions.choice: santificar (L, B); hacer santo (R) (for the whole letter)
alternatives: hacer santo at every level, as the English Balanced
decisions.reason: "Santificar" is the Spanish word for making holy and setting apart for God (m1) and stays recognisable across Hebrews (10:10, 10:14, 13:12), so Balanced keeps it where the English Balanced says "makes holy". Readable says "hacer santo".

decisions.choice: ndugu, no gender setting (for the whole letter)
alternatives: ndugu wa kiume na wa kike
decisions.reason: "Ndugu" already means brothers and sisters, so the Swahili has no gender span where the English has {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, here and throughout Hebrews.

decisions.choice: kutakasa (L, B); kuwafanya watakatifu (R); kusanyiko (for the whole letter)
decisions.reason: "Kutakasa" is the settled word for "sanctify, make holy" in Hebrews; Readable says it plainly, "make people holy", as the English Readable does. The psalm's "assembly" is "kusanyiko", the gathered people of God, not "kanisa", which would read a later word for the church back into the psalm.

decisions.choice: {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}} (for the whole letter)
decisions.reason: The brothers are the whole family of believers, women and men (meaning decision m3), so French follows the English: "frères et sœurs" by default, the traditional "frères" as the alternative. Possessives before the span ("mes", "ses", "vos") are plural in both options and read correctly either way.

decisions.choice: sanctifier (L, B); rendre saint (R) (for the whole letter)
alternatives: rendre saint at Balanced too, as the English "makes holy"
decisions.reason: "Sanctifier" is the established French word and is understood in careful public reading, so Balanced keeps it where the English Balanced says "makes holy"; Readable explains it with "rendre saint".

decisions.choice: Jesus says "Con" of himself and "Ngài" to God in the words of Psalm 22 (2:12), and "Ta" in the words of Isaiah (2:13)
decisions.reason: The style guide gives Jesus "Con" for himself when he speaks to the Father (John 17), so the psalm's words to God take "Con"; "Con" is a noun of address and takes no setting span. In 2:13 he speaks about God, not to him, so he says "Ta", as the style guide sets for Jesus speaking.

decisions.choice: "làm cho nên thánh" for sanctify (also 10:10, 10:14, 13:12)
decisions.reason: To sanctify is to make holy, set apart for God and cleansed (m1). "Nên thánh" is the church word of the Vietnamese Romans (6:19) and 1 Thessalonians (4:3); "thánh hóa" is the Catholic word.

decisions.choice: "hội chúng" (L, B); "dân sự đang nhóm lại" (R) for the assembly
decisions.reason: The assembly here is the gathered people of God in the psalm (m5); "Hội Thánh" would name the church.

decisions.choice: the Son speaks to God in 합쇼체 with the humble "저", calling him "주님", in the words of Psalm 22 (2:12)
decisions.reason: As Jesus prays to the Father in 합쇼체 in the Korean John 17 (Korean style guide, Settled), and as the psalmist addresses God (section 7a). His sayings about God in 2:13 are statements, in 해라체.

decisions.choice: "한 분에게서" (L), "한 근원에서" (B), "같은 아버지에게서" (R); "회중" (L, B), "모인 백성" (R) for the assembly
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads "from one" as from one Father, God, and footnotes other readings; Literal and Balanced keep it as open as the English, and Readable follows the English Readable. The assembly is the gathered people of God in the psalm (meaning decision), so it is "회중", not the "교회" of the Christian churches.

decisions.choice: santifica, são santificados
decisions.reason: The English Balanced says "make holy" because "sanctify" is a church word. Portuguese "santificar" is an ordinary word Brazilians know, and "os que são tornados santos" would be clumsy, so Balanced keeps it; Readable says "torna as pessoas santas".

decisions.choice: {{gender:ወንድሞችና እኅቶች|ወንድሞች}}, with the suffix and the prefix inside each option
decisions.reason: As in Romans: the believers Jesus calls his family include the sisters, so the default names both and the alternative keeps ወንድሞች. Suffixes (-ቹ, -ቼ) and the prefix ለ- go inside each option.

source.text: καὶ πάλιν· Ἐγὼ ἔσομαι πεποιθὼς ἐπ’ αὐτῷ· καὶ πάλιν· Ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ καὶ τὰ παιδία ἅ μοι ἔδωκεν ὁ θεός.

records.literal_gloss: And again, I will be trusting in him; and again, See I and the children whom to me gave the God.

en.L: And again, "I will be trusting in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}." And again, "See, I and the children whom God has given {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}."
en.B: And again, "I will go on trusting in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}." And again, "Here I am, with the children God has given {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}."
en.R: In another place {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} says, "I will keep on trusting God." He also says, "Here I am, together with the children God has given {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}."

es.L: Y otra vez: «Yo estaré confiando en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}». Y otra vez: «He aquí yo y los hijos que Dios {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} dio».
es.B: Y otra vez: «Seguiré confiando en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}». Y otra vez: «Aquí estoy, con los hijos que Dios {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} ha dado».
es.R: En otro lugar dice: «Seguiré confiando en Dios». También dice: «Aquí estoy, junto con los hijos que Dios {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} ha dado».

fr.L: Et encore : « Moi, je serai confiant en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. » Et encore : « Voici : moi et les enfants que Dieu {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}a donnés. »
fr.B: Et encore : « Je continuerai à mettre ma confiance en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. » Et encore : « Me voici, moi, avec les enfants que Dieu {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}a donnés. »
fr.R: Ailleurs {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dit : « Je continuerai à faire confiance à Dieu. » Il dit aussi : « Je suis ici avec les enfants que Dieu {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}a donnés. »

sw.L: Na tena, "Mimi nitakuwa mwenye kumtegemea {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}." Na tena, "Tazama, {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} pamoja na watoto ambao Mungu amenipa."
sw.B: Na tena, "Nitaendelea kumtumaini {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}." Na tena, "Mimi hapa, pamoja na watoto ambao Mungu amenipa."
sw.R: Mahali pengine anasema, "Nitaendelea kumtegemea Mungu." Tena anasema, "Mimi hapa, pamoja na watoto ambao Mungu amenipa."

vi.L: Và lại: "Ta sẽ tin cậy nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}." Và lại: "Này, Ta cùng những con cái mà Đức Chúa Trời đã ban cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}."
vi.B: Và lại: "Ta sẽ luôn tin cậy nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}." Và lại: "Ta đây, cùng với những con cái Đức Chúa Trời đã ban cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}."
vi.R: Ở một chỗ khác {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phán: "Ta sẽ luôn tin cậy Đức Chúa Trời." Ngài cũng phán: "Ta đây, cùng với những con cái Đức Chúa Trời đã ban cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}."

ko.L: 그리고 다시 "나는 그분을 신뢰할 것이다." 그리고 다시 "보라, 나와, 하나님께서 나에게 주신 자녀들이 [여기 있다]."
ko.B: 또 "나는 그분을 계속 신뢰하겠다" 하시고, 또 "보라, 내가 여기 있고, 하나님께서 내게 주신 자녀들도 함께 있다" 하십니다.
ko.R: 다른 곳에서 그분은 "나는 하나님을 계속 믿고 의지하겠다" 하고 말씀하십니다. 또 "보라, 내가 하나님께서 내게 주신 자녀들과 함께 여기 있다" 하고 말씀하십니다.

pt.L: E outra vez: "Eu estarei confiando {{deity_pronoun:nele|Nele}}." E outra vez: "Eis [aqui] eu e os filhos que Deus {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} deu."
pt.B: E ainda: "Continuarei confiando {{deity_pronoun:nele|Nele}}." E ainda: "Aqui estou eu, com os filhos que Deus {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} deu."
pt.R: Em outro lugar {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} diz: "Vou continuar confiando em Deus." Ele também diz: "Aqui estou eu, junto com os filhos que Deus {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} deu."

am.L: ደግሞም፦ «እኔ በእርሱ ታምኜ እኖራለሁ።» ደግሞም፦ «እነሆ፣ እኔና እግዚአብሔር የሰጠኝ ልጆች።»
am.B: ደግሞም፦ «በእርሱ መታመኔን እቀጥላለሁ።» ደግሞም፦ «እኔና እግዚአብሔር የሰጠኝ ልጆች ይኸው እዚህ አለን።»
am.R: በሌላ ስፍራም እንዲህ ይላል፦ «በእግዚአብሔር መታመኔን እቀጥላለሁ።» ደግሞም እንዲህ ይላል፦ «እኔና እግዚአብሔር የሰጠኝ ልጆች ይኸው አብረን እዚህ አለን።»

decisions.choice: Isaiah 8:17 (Greek); compare 2 Samuel 22:3 and Isaiah 12:2
decisions.reason: The words "I will trust in him" match the Greek of Isaiah 8:17, where the prophet waits for God while God hides his face from Israel. The Hebrew of Isaiah 8:17 says "I will hope in him". Similar words occur in the Greek of 2 Samuel 22:3 and Isaiah 12:2, but the next quotation, from Isaiah 8:18, shows that Isaiah 8 is meant.

decisions.choice: Isaiah 8:18
decisions.reason: In Isaiah 8:18 the prophet says that he and the children God has given him are signs to Israel; the Hebrew has the divine name, YHWH, where the Greek has "God". The author hears in it the voice of Jesus, standing with the people God has given him.

decisions.choice: I will be trusting: Jesus, as a human being, lived in steady trust in God
decisions.reason: The construction ἔσομαι πεποιθὼς ("I will be one who trusts") describes a lasting state. The point is that Jesus shares the life of those he saves: like them he depended on God and trusted him (5:7; 12:2).

decisions.choice: the children: believers, the family God has given to Jesus
decisions.reason: παιδίον are the "many sons" of verse 10 and the brothers and sisters of verses 11-12. They are God's gift to Jesus (compare John 6:37; 17:6).

decisions.choice: Here I am
decisions.reason: The word traditionally rendered "behold" calls for attention; Balanced and Readable say "Here I am", and Literal "See".

decisions.choice: In another place {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} says; trusting God
decisions.reason: Readable says that these are further words of Jesus from Scripture, and names God as the one he trusts.

source.text: Ἐπεὶ οὖν τὰ παιδία κεκοινώνηκεν αἵματος καὶ σαρκός, καὶ αὐτὸς παραπλησίως μετέσχεν τῶν αὐτῶν, ἵνα διὰ τοῦ θανάτου καταργήσῃ τὸν τὸ κράτος ἔχοντα τοῦ θανάτου, τοῦτ’ ἔστι τὸν διάβολον, καὶ ἀπαλλάξῃ τούτους, ὅσοι φόβῳ θανάτου διὰ παντὸς τοῦ ζῆν ἔνοχοι ἦσαν δουλείας.

records.literal_gloss: Since therefore the children have shared in blood and flesh, also he likewise partook of the same, so that through the death he might render powerless the [one] the power having of the death, that is, the devil, \v 15 and might set free these, as many as by fear of death through all the to live subject were to slavery.

en.L: Since then the children have had a share of blood and flesh, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} also in like manner had a part in the same [things], so that through death {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} might render powerless the one having the power of death, that is, the devil, \v 15 and set free those who, by fear of death, through all [their] living were subject to slavery.
en.B: Since the children, then, share a common life of flesh and blood, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} took on that same life in the same way, so that by {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} death {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} might strip of power the one who holds the power of death, the devil, \v 15 and release those whom the fear of death kept enslaved their whole life long.
en.R: These children are human beings, with flesh and blood. So Jesus also became a human being like them. He died, and by {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} death {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} took away all the power of the devil, who had the power of death. \v 15 All their lives people were slaves to their fear of death. Jesus died to set them free.

es.L: Así que, puesto que los hijos han participado de sangre y carne, también {{deity_pronoun:él mismo|Él mismo}} de igual manera tomó parte de lo mismo, para que por medio de la muerte dejara sin poder al que tenía el poder de la muerte, es decir, al diablo, \v 15 y librara a todos estos que por temor a la muerte estaban sujetos a esclavitud durante toda [su] vida.
es.B: Ya que los hijos, entonces, comparten una misma vida de carne y sangre, {{deity_pronoun:él mismo|Él mismo}} tomó esa misma vida de igual manera, para que por medio de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} muerte despojara de su poder al que tiene el poder de la muerte, el diablo, \v 15 y librara a los que el miedo a la muerte tenía esclavizados durante toda su vida.
es.R: Estos hijos son seres humanos, con carne y sangre. Por eso Jesús también se hizo ser humano como ellos. Murió, y por medio de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} muerte le quitó todo su poder al diablo, que tenía el poder de la muerte. \v 15 Durante toda su vida la gente vivía esclava de su miedo a la muerte. Jesús murió para liberarla.

fr.L: Puisque donc les enfants ont eu part au sang et à la chair, {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} aussi a pareillement pris part aux mêmes [choses], afin que par la mort {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} rende impuissant celui qui a le pouvoir de la mort, c’est-à-dire le diable, \v 15 et qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} libère ceux qui, par crainte de la mort, pendant toute [leur] vie étaient assujettis à l’esclavage.
fr.B: Puisque donc les enfants partagent une même vie de chair et de sang, {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} a pris de la même manière cette même vie, afin de réduire à l’impuissance, par {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} mort, celui qui détient le pouvoir de la mort, le diable, \v 15 et de délivrer ceux que la peur de la mort tenait en esclavage toute leur vie.
fr.R: Ces enfants sont des êtres humains, faits de chair et de sang. Alors Jésus aussi est devenu un être humain comme eux. Il est mort, et par {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} mort {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a enlevé tout son pouvoir au diable, qui avait le pouvoir de la mort. \v 15 Toute leur vie, les gens étaient esclaves de leur peur de la mort. Jésus est mort pour les libérer.

sw.L: Basi kwa kuwa watoto wamekuwa na sehemu katika damu na mwili, {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} pia kwa namna iliyo sawa alipata sehemu katika [mambo] hayo hayo, ili kupitia kifo amvunjie nguvu yule aliye na mamlaka ya kifo, yaani, Ibilisi, \v 15 na kuwaweka huru wale wote ambao, kwa kuogopa kifo, katika kuishi kwao kote walikuwa wamefungwa katika utumwa.
sw.B: Basi, kwa kuwa watoto wanashiriki maisha ya pamoja ya mwili na damu, {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} aliyapokea maisha hayo hayo kwa namna ile ile, ili kwa kifo {{deity_pronoun:chake|Chake}} amnyang'anye nguvu yule anayeshika mamlaka ya kifo, yaani Ibilisi, \v 15 na kuwaweka huru wale ambao hofu ya kifo iliwaweka utumwani maisha yao yote.
sw.R: Watoto hao ni wanadamu wenye mwili na damu. Kwa hiyo Yesu naye akawa mwanadamu kama wao. Alikufa, na kwa kifo {{deity_pronoun:chake|Chake}} aliondoa nguvu zote za Ibilisi, aliyekuwa na nguvu ya kifo. \v 15 Maisha yao yote watu walikuwa watumwa wa hofu yao ya kifo. Yesu alikufa ili awaweke huru.

vi.L: Vậy, vì con cái đều có chung huyết và thịt, thì chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cũng đã dự phần vào những điều ấy cách tương tự, để bởi sự chết {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tiêu diệt quyền lực của kẻ cầm quyền sự chết, tức là ma quỷ, \v 15 và giải thoát những người vì sợ sự chết mà suốt đời phải sống trong cảnh nô lệ.
vi.B: Vậy, vì con cái đều có chung một đời sống thịt và huyết, thì chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cũng đã mang lấy đời sống ấy cách tương tự, để bởi sự chết của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tước bỏ quyền lực của kẻ cầm quyền sự chết, là ma quỷ, \v 15 và giải thoát những người suốt đời bị nỗi sợ sự chết bắt làm nô lệ.
vi.R: Những con cái ấy là con người, có thịt và máu. Vì vậy Đức Giê-xu cũng đã trở nên con người giống như họ. Ngài đã chết, và bởi sự chết của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã cất bỏ hết quyền lực của ma quỷ, là kẻ cầm quyền sự chết. \v 15 Suốt đời, người ta làm nô lệ cho nỗi sợ chết. Đức Giê-xu đã chết để giải thoát họ.

ko.L: 그러므로 자녀들이 피와 살을 함께 나누어 가졌으므로, 그분 자신도 마찬가지로 같은 것들을 함께 가지셨습니다. 이는 죽음을 통하여 죽음의 세력을 가진 자, 곧 마귀를 무력하게 하시고, \v 15 죽음의 두려움 때문에 평생 종살이에 매여 있던 사람들을 풀어 주시려는 것이었습니다.
ko.B: 자녀들이 살과 피를 가진 사람으로 함께 살기 때문에, 그분도 그와 똑같이 살과 피를 지니셨습니다. 이는 그분이 자신의 죽음으로 죽음의 권세를 쥔 자, 곧 마귀의 힘을 꺾으시고, \v 15 죽음의 두려움 때문에 평생 종으로 매여 살던 사람들을 풀어 주시려는 것이었습니다.
ko.R: 이 자녀들은 살과 피를 가진 사람들입니다. 그래서 예수께서도 그들과 같은 사람이 되셨습니다. 그분은 죽으셨고, 그 죽음으로 죽음의 힘을 가진 마귀의 모든 힘을 없애 버리셨습니다. \v 15 사람들은 평생 죽음을 두려워하며 그 두려움의 종으로 살았습니다. 예수께서는 그들을 자유롭게 하시려고 죽으셨습니다.

pt.L: Visto, pois, que os filhos têm participado de sangue e carne, também {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} mesmo, de modo semelhante, tomou parte das mesmas [coisas], para que, por meio da morte, reduzisse à impotência aquele que tem o poder da morte, isto é, o diabo, \v 15 e libertasse todos estes que, pelo medo da morte, por toda a [sua] vida estavam sujeitos à escravidão.
pt.B: Já que os filhos, então, têm em comum uma vida de carne e sangue, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} mesmo assumiu igualmente essa vida, para que, pela {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} morte, tirasse o poder daquele que detém o poder da morte, o diabo, \v 15 e libertasse aqueles que o medo da morte mantinha escravizados a vida inteira.
pt.R: Esses filhos são seres humanos, de carne e sangue. Por isso Jesus também se tornou um ser humano como eles. Ele morreu, e pela {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} morte {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} tirou todo o poder do diabo, que tinha o poder da morte. \v 15 A vida inteira as pessoas eram escravas do medo da morte. Jesus morreu para libertá-las.

am.L: እንግዲህ ልጆቹ ደምንና ሥጋን ስለ ተካፈሉ፣ እርሱ ራሱ ደግሞ እንዲሁ ከእነዚሁ ተካፈለ፤ ይኸውም በሞት በኩል የሞት ሥልጣን ያለውን፣ ማለትም ዲያብሎስን፣ ሽሮ፣ \v 15 በሕይወት ዘመናቸው ሁሉ በሞት ፍርሃት ለባርነት የተገዙትን እነዚህን ሁሉ ነጻ ያወጣ ዘንድ ነው።
am.B: እንግዲህ ልጆቹ የሥጋና የደም ሕይወት ተካፋዮች ስለ ሆኑ፣ እርሱ ራሱ ደግሞ በዚያው መንገድ ያንኑ ሕይወት ወሰደ፤ ይኸውም በሞቱ የሞት ሥልጣን ያለውን ዲያብሎስን ኃይል አሳጥቶ፣ \v 15 በሞት ፍርሃት ዕድሜ ልካቸውን በባርነት የተያዙትን ነጻ ያወጣ ዘንድ ነው።
am.R: እነዚህ ልጆች ሥጋና ደም ያላቸው ሰዎች ናቸው። ስለዚህ ኢየሱስ ደግሞ እንደ እነርሱ ሰው ሆነ። እርሱ ሞተ፤ በሞቱም የሞት ሥልጣን የነበረውን የዲያብሎስን ኃይል ሁሉ ወሰደበት። \v 15 ሰዎች በሕይወት ዘመናቸው ሁሉ ለሞት ፍርሃት ባሮች ነበሩ። ኢየሱስ የሞተው እነርሱን ነጻ ለማውጣት ነው።

decisions.choice: blood and flesh: human nature, weak and mortal
decisions.reason: "Blood and flesh" (in this order also in Ephesians 6:12) means human beings in their frailty and mortality (compare Matthew 16:17).

decisions.choice: the children share it; he took part in it: the Son became human by his own choice
decisions.reason: The children "have shared" (perfect tense): human nature is what they are. He "took part" (aorist): at a point in time he took the same nature on himself. παραπλησίως ("in the same way, likewise") stresses that his humanity was real and not a mere appearance.

decisions.choice: render powerless: break the devil's hold, bring his power to nothing
decisions.reason: καταργέω means "make ineffective, abolish, render powerless". The devil is not said to cease to exist, but his power over death, and so over those who fear it, is broken.

decisions.choice: the one who holds the power of death: the devil
decisions.reason: Death came into the world through sin, after the serpent's deceit (Genesis 3; Romans 5:12), and the Wisdom of Solomon says that death entered the world through the devil's envy (Wisdom of Solomon 2:24). Jesus called the devil a murderer from the beginning (John 8:44). By dying, Jesus took away the hold the devil had through death.

decisions.choice: slavery through fear of death: a whole life held captive by dread of dying
decisions.reason: δουλεία is slavery. The fear of death enslaves because it rules a person's choices for the whole of life. Jesus, who went through death, sets free those who were held by that fear.

decisions.choice: flesh and blood
decisions.reason: The Greek says "blood and flesh"; Literal keeps that order. Balanced and Readable use the usual order "flesh and blood", which means the same.

decisions.choice: So Jesus also became a human being like them; Jesus died to set them free
decisions.reason: Readable names Jesus and says plainly that "took part in the same things" means he became a human being. It breaks the long sentence and repeats the point of his death in verse 15.

decisions.choice: kept enslaved (B); slaves to (R)
decisions.reason: "Slave" at every level, as the style guide keeps it for slavery set against freedom: Jesus sets free those whom the fear of death held as slaves (m5).

decisions.choice: "nô lệ" at every level for the slavery of the fear of death
decisions.reason: This is slavery set against being set free (m5), so Vietnamese keeps "nô lệ" at every level, as the English keeps "slavery" and "slaves"; "đầy tớ" would lose the captivity.

decisions.choice: "huyết và thịt" (L), "thịt và huyết" (B); "thịt và máu" (R)
decisions.reason: The phrase means human nature, weak and mortal (m1). Literal keeps the Greek order; "huyết" is the church word, and Readable uses the everyday "máu".

source.text: οὐ γὰρ δήπου ἀγγέλων ἐπιλαμβάνεται, ἀλλὰ σπέρματος Ἀβραὰμ ἐπιλαμβάνεται.

records.literal_gloss: Not for surely angels he takes hold of, but [the] seed of Abraham he takes hold of.

en.L: For surely {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} does not take hold of angels, but {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} takes hold of [the] seed of Abraham.
en.B: For it is clear that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} does not take hold of angels to help them; it is Abraham's descendants that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} takes hold of.
en.R: It is clear that Jesus does not reach out to help angels. He reaches out to help Abraham's descendants.

es.L: Porque ciertamente no echa mano de ángeles, sino que echa mano de [la] simiente de Abraham.
es.B: Porque es evidente que no echa mano de los ángeles para ayudarlos; es de los descendientes de Abraham de quienes echa mano.
es.R: Es claro que Jesús no extiende la mano para ayudar a los ángeles. Extiende la mano para ayudar a los descendientes de Abraham.

fr.L: Car assurément ce n’est pas des anges qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} saisit, mais c’est [la] semence d’Abraham qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} saisit.
fr.B: Car il est clair que ce n’est pas des anges qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} saisit pour les secourir ; ce sont les descendants d’Abraham qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} saisit.
fr.R: Il est clair que Jésus ne tend pas la main pour aider les anges. Il tend la main pour aider les descendants d’Abraham.

sw.L: Kwa maana hakika si malaika anaowashika, bali anaushika uzao wa Ibrahimu.
sw.B: Kwa maana ni wazi kwamba hawashiki malaika ili kuwasaidia; ni wazao wa Ibrahimu ndio anaowashika.
sw.R: Ni wazi kwamba Yesu hawanyooshei malaika mkono ili kuwasaidia. Anawanyooshea mkono wazao wa Ibrahimu ili kuwasaidia.

vi.L: Vì chắc chắn {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không nắm lấy các thiên sứ, nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nắm lấy dòng dõi Áp-ra-ham.
vi.B: Vì rõ ràng là {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không nắm lấy các thiên sứ để giúp đỡ họ; nhưng chính dòng dõi Áp-ra-ham mới là những người {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nắm lấy.
vi.R: Rõ ràng là Đức Giê-xu không đưa tay ra giúp các thiên sứ. Ngài đưa tay ra giúp dòng dõi của Áp-ra-ham.

ko.L: 참으로 그분은 천사들을 붙드시는 것이 아니라 아브라함의 씨를 붙드십니다.
ko.B: 분명히 그분은 천사들을 붙들어 도우시는 것이 아니라, 아브라함의 후손을 붙들어 도우십니다.
ko.R: 예수께서는 천사들을 도우려고 손을 내미시지 않는다는 것이 분명합니다. 그분은 아브라함의 자손을 도우려고 손을 내미십니다.

pt.L: Pois certamente não são anjos que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} toma pela mão, mas é a descendência de Abraão que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} toma pela mão.
pt.B: Pois é claro que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} não toma pela mão os anjos para socorrê-los; são os descendentes de Abraão que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} toma pela mão.
pt.R: É claro que Jesus não estende a mão para ajudar os anjos. Ele estende a mão para ajudar os descendentes de Abraão.

am.L: መላእክትን በእርግጥ አይይዝምና፤ ነገር ግን የአብርሃምን ዘር ይይዛል።
am.B: ሊረዳቸው የሚይዘው መላእክትን እንዳልሆነ ግልጽ ነው፤ የሚይዘው የአብርሃምን ዘሮች ነው።
am.R: ኢየሱስ እጁን ዘርግቶ የሚረዳው መላእክትን እንዳልሆነ ግልጽ ነው። የሚረዳው የአብርሃምን ዘሮች ነው።

decisions.choice: take hold of: grasp in order to help and rescue
decisions.reason: ἐπιλαμβάνομαι means "take hold of, grasp", often to help someone. Hebrews uses it in 8:9 of God taking Israel by the hand to lead them out of Egypt. An older reading took it as "take on (the nature of)", as if the verse said that Christ took on human nature rather than angelic nature; but the verb does not have that sense.

decisions.choice: the seed of Abraham: Abraham's descendants, God's people
decisions.reason: "The seed of Abraham" means Abraham's descendants, the people of God's promise (Isaiah 41:8-10), and so the people of faith whom Jesus helps (compare Galatians 3:29). It may also show that the author's readers knew themselves as heirs of Israel.

decisions.choice: surely: as everyone knows
decisions.reason: δήπου means "of course, surely": the author appeals to something the readers can see for themselves.

decisions.choice: take hold of ... to help them (R: reaches out to help)
decisions.reason: Balanced adds "to help them" to show why he takes hold of them (m1); Readable says "reaches out to help".

decisions.choice: Jesus
decisions.reason: Readable names Jesus as the subject.

decisions.choice: saisir
decisions.reason: "Saisir" keeps the picture of taking hold of someone in order to rescue them (meaning decision m1). The reflexive "se saisir de" would put a reflexive pronoun for Jesus outside the deity_pronoun forms, and "venir en aide" loses the picture, which Balanced explains with "pour les secourir".

decisions.choice: "dòng dõi Áp-ra-ham" at every level
decisions.reason: The word settled for "seed" in the Vietnamese Romans (4:13; 9:7), God's people as Abraham's descendants (m2).

decisions.choice: "아브라함의 씨" (L), "후손" (B), "자손" (R)
decisions.reason: The wording of the Korean Romans 9:7, so Abraham's offspring reads alike in both letters.

decisions.choice: toma pela mão
decisions.reason: "Tomar pela mão" keeps the picture of grasping someone to help them (m1) and matches 8:9, where God takes Israel by the hand; "assumir" would give the older reading "take on the nature of", which m1 sets aside.

source.text: ὅθεν ὤφειλεν κατὰ πάντα τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς ὁμοιωθῆναι, ἵνα ἐλεήμων γένηται καὶ πιστὸς ἀρχιερεὺς τὰ πρὸς τὸν θεόν, εἰς τὸ ἱλάσκεσθαι τὰς ἁμαρτίας τοῦ λαοῦ·

records.literal_gloss: From where he was obligated in all things to the brothers to be made like, so that merciful he might become and faithful high priest [in] the things toward the God, for the to make atonement for the sins of the people;

en.L: Therefore {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was obligated to be made like [{{deity_pronoun:his|His}}] {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}} in all things, so that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} might become a merciful and faithful high priest [in] the things relating to God, to make atonement for the sins of the people.
en.B: That is why it was necessary for {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to become like {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}} in every way, so that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} might be a merciful and faithful high priest in all that has to do with God, making atonement for the sins of the people.
en.R: So Jesus had to become like {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}} in every way. Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} could become a high priest who is merciful and faithful as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} serves God. As high priest {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} would take away the sins of the people.

es.L: Por lo cual estaba obligado a ser hecho semejante en todo a [{{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}}] hermanos, para llegar a ser un sumo sacerdote misericordioso y fiel [en] las cosas que se refieren a Dios, para hacer expiación por los pecados del pueblo.
es.B: Por eso era necesario que se hiciera semejante a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} hermanos en todo, para ser un sumo sacerdote misericordioso y fiel en todo lo que tiene que ver con Dios, y hacer expiación por los pecados del pueblo.
es.R: Por eso Jesús tuvo que hacerse igual a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} hermanos en todo. Así podía llegar a ser un sumo sacerdote misericordioso y fiel en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} servicio a Dios. Como sumo sacerdote, quitaría los pecados del pueblo.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} devait être rendu semblable en toutes choses à [{{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}}] {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, afin de devenir un grand prêtre miséricordieux et fidèle [dans] les choses qui se rapportent à Dieu, pour faire l’expiation des péchés du peuple.
fr.B: C’est pourquoi il fallait qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} devienne en tout semblable à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, afin d’être un grand prêtre miséricordieux et fidèle dans tout ce qui touche à Dieu, et de faire l’expiation des péchés du peuple.
fr.R: Jésus devait donc devenir en tout semblable à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}. Alors {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} pourrait devenir un grand prêtre plein de compassion et fidèle quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} sert Dieu. Comme grand prêtre, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} enlèverait les péchés du peuple.

sw.L: Kwa sababu hiyo alipaswa katika mambo yote kufanywa sawa na ndugu [{{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}], ili awe kuhani mkuu mwenye huruma na mwaminifu [katika] mambo yaliyo kwa Mungu, kwa ajili ya kufanya upatanisho wa dhambi za watu.
sw.B: Ndiyo sababu ilikuwa lazima afanane na ndugu {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} kwa kila namna, ili awe kuhani mkuu mwenye huruma na mwaminifu katika yote yanayomhusu Mungu, akifanya upatanisho kwa ajili ya dhambi za watu.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo Yesu alilazimika kuwa kama ndugu {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} kwa kila namna. Ndipo angeweza kuwa kuhani mkuu mwenye huruma na mwaminifu anapomtumikia Mungu. Kama kuhani mkuu angeziondoa dhambi za watu.

vi.L: Bởi vậy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phải trở nên giống [các] {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} [{{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}] trong mọi sự, để trở thành thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm thương xót và trung tín trong những việc thuộc về Đức Chúa Trời, để chuộc tội cho dân.
vi.B: Vì vậy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phải trở nên giống các {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trong mọi phương diện, để làm thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm đầy lòng thương xót và trung tín trong mọi việc liên quan đến Đức Chúa Trời, và chuộc tội cho dân.
vi.R: Vì vậy Đức Giê-xu phải trở nên giống các {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trong mọi phương diện. Khi đó {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} có thể trở thành thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm đầy lòng thương xót và trung tín trong khi phục vụ Đức Chúa Trời. Là thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ cất đi tội lỗi của dân.

ko.L: 그러므로 그분은 모든 일에서 [그분의] {{gender:형제자매|형제}}들과 같아지셔야 했습니다. 이는 하나님께 대한 일들에 자비롭고 신실한 대제사장이 되셔서, 백성의 죄를 속하시려는 것이었습니다.
ko.B: 그러므로 그분은 모든 면에서 자기 {{gender:형제자매|형제}}들과 같아지셔야 했습니다. 그래야 하나님을 섬기는 모든 일에서 자비롭고 신실한 대제사장이 되셔서, 백성의 죄를 속하여 주실 수 있었습니다.
ko.R: 그래서 예수께서는 모든 면에서 그분의 {{gender:형제자매|형제}}들과 같아지셔야 했습니다. 그래야 그분이 하나님을 섬기실 때 자비롭고 신실한 대제사장이 되실 수 있었습니다. 대제사장으로서 그분은 백성의 죄를 없애 주실 것이었습니다.

pt.L: Por isso {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} devia ser feito semelhante aos [{{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}}] {{gender:irmãos e irmãs|irmãos}} em todas as coisas, para que se tornasse um sumo sacerdote misericordioso e fiel [nas] coisas relativas a Deus, para fazer expiação pelos pecados do povo.
pt.B: Por isso era necessário que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se tornasse semelhante aos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} {{gender:irmãos e irmãs|irmãos}} em tudo, para ser um sumo sacerdote misericordioso e fiel em tudo o que diz respeito a Deus, fazendo expiação pelos pecados do povo.
pt.R: Por isso Jesus teve de se tornar igual aos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} {{gender:irmãos e irmãs|irmãos}} em tudo. Assim {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} podia se tornar um sumo sacerdote misericordioso e fiel no {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} serviço a Deus. Como sumo sacerdote, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} ia tirar os pecados do povo.

am.L: ስለዚህ በሁሉ ነገር {{gender:ወንድሞቹንና እኅቶቹን|ወንድሞቹን}} ሊመስል ግድ ሆነበት፤ ይኸውም በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ባሉት ነገሮች መሐሪና ታማኝ ሊቀ ካህናት ይሆን ዘንድ፣ የሕዝቡንም ኃጢአት ያስተሰርይ ዘንድ ነው።
am.B: ስለዚህ በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ በሚደረገው አገልግሎት ሁሉ መሐሪና ታማኝ ሊቀ ካህናት ይሆን ዘንድ፣ የሕዝቡንም ኃጢአት ያስተሰርይ ዘንድ፣ በሁሉ ነገር {{gender:ወንድሞቹንና እኅቶቹን|ወንድሞቹን}} መምሰል አስፈለገው።
am.R: ስለዚህ ኢየሱስ በሁሉ ነገር {{gender:ወንድሞቹንና እኅቶቹን|ወንድሞቹን}} መምሰል ነበረበት። ያን ጊዜ እግዚአብሔርን ሲያገለግል መሐሪና ታማኝ ሊቀ ካህናት ሊሆን ቻለ። እንደ ሊቀ ካህናትም የሕዝቡን ኃጢአት ያስወግዳል።

decisions.choice: was obligated to be made like them in all things: it was necessary for his task
decisions.reason: ὀφείλω is "owe, be obligated". Given what he came to do, Jesus had to share his brothers' and sisters' life in every respect: their flesh and blood, testing and death. Hebrews 4:15 adds the one exception, that he did not sin.

decisions.choice: high priest: the chief priest of Israel, who once a year made atonement for the people
decisions.reason: This is the first time Hebrews calls Jesus high priest, the theme of 4:14 to 10:18. In Israel the high priest alone entered the Most Holy Place, once a year on the Day of Atonement, with blood for his own sins and the people's (Leviticus 16).

decisions.choice: merciful and faithful: compassionate toward people, faithful toward God
decisions.reason: A good high priest must feel with the weak (5:2) and be faithful to the one who appointed him (3:2, where Jesus is compared with faithful Moses). πιστός means "faithful, trustworthy".

decisions.choice: the things relating to God: priestly service toward God
decisions.reason: "The things toward God" is a set phrase for the priest's service on behalf of the people before God (5:1).

decisions.choice: make atonement for the sins: deal with sins so that they no longer stand between the people and God
decisions.reason: ἱλάσκομαι is the word family of the Day of Atonement and the mercy seat (9:5). With "the sins" as its object it means to remove or cover sins, the barrier between the people and God, so that God can be gracious to them. Others render it "make propitiation for", stressing that sin deserves God's anger, which is also turned away when sin is dealt with.

decisions.choice: {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}
decisions.reason: Those Jesus became like are women and men, so the gender setting applies, as in verses 11-12.

decisions.choice: take away
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced say "make atonement for". Readable says "take away", which a young reader understands, and which states the result of atonement (m5).

decisions.choice: Jesus
decisions.reason: Readable names Jesus as the subject.

decisions.choice: sumo sacerdote (for the whole letter)
decisions.reason: "Sumo sacerdote" is the established Spanish name for the chief priest of Israel (m2), and it is used for the same word throughout Hebrews; "sacerdote" and "sacerdocio" are used for priest and priesthood.

decisions.choice: kuhani mkuu (for the whole letter)
decisions.reason: "Kuhani mkuu" names the one high priest of Israel, the office Hebrews compares with Christ's. "Mkuu wa makuhani" (chief of the priests) is the word for the leading priests in the gospels, a group, and would blur that.

decisions.choice: mwenye huruma (merciful)
decisions.reason: "Huruma" is the compassion one feels for someone in trouble, which is what meaning decision m3 describes (compassionate toward people); "rehema" leans toward God's mercy in pardoning, and is kept for that (4:16).

decisions.choice: grand prêtre (for the whole letter)
decisions.reason: "Grand prêtre", without a hyphen, is the usual modern French term for the chief priest of Israel. "Souverain sacrificateur" belongs to older Protestant French and is no longer understood by most readers. Priest and priesthood are "prêtre" and "sacerdoce" throughout the letter.

decisions.choice: "thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm" for the high priest at every level, through the letter; "thầy tế lễ" for a priest
decisions.reason: The style guide's Protestant title for the high priest, used for Caiaphas in the Vietnamese John and the Gospels, and "thầy tế lễ" for a priest, as in the Vietnamese Luke (1:5). Hebrews uses the same word for Israel's high priests and for Jesus, so Vietnamese keeps one word for both.

decisions.choice: "chuộc tội cho dân" (L, B); "cất đi tội lỗi của dân" (R)
decisions.reason: To make atonement is to deal with sins so that they no longer stand between the people and God (m5). "Chuộc tội" is the church word for atonement, as in the Vietnamese Romans (3:25) and 1 John (2:2); Readable says what it does, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "대제사장" for high priest and "제사장" for priest at every level, through the letter; "죄를 속하다" (L, B), "죄를 없애 주다" (R) for making atonement
decisions.reason: "대제사장" is the word of the Korean Gospels (Mark 14:1) and is plain enough for Readable. To make atonement is to deal with sins so that they no longer stand between the people and God (meaning decision, footnoted); "속하다" is the verb behind "속죄 제물" in the Korean 1 John 2:2, and Readable says what it does, as the English Readable says "take away".

decisions.choice: o sumo sacerdote
decisions.reason: For the whole book: "sumo sacerdote" at every level, the established Portuguese term (style section 6), from this first use of the title for Jesus through chapters 4-10.

decisions.choice: fazer expiação pelos pecados
decisions.reason: For the whole book: "expiação" is the Portuguese word of the Day of Atonement ("o Dia da Expiação"), which m5 describes; Readable says "tirar os pecados", as the English Readable says "take away".

decisions.choice: ሊቀ ካህናት (high priest), through Hebrews
decisions.reason: The church's word for the high priest is the living word for the office and the one the Gospels use (style brief table); Hebrews' central title keeps it at every level.

decisions.choice: ያስተሰርይ ዘንድ (to make atonement)
decisions.reason: ማስተስረይ is the word for the atoning work of a priest (ስርየት); Readable says plainly that he takes the sins away, as the English Readable does.

source.text: ἐν ᾧ γὰρ πέπονθεν αὐτὸς πειρασθείς, δύναται τοῖς πειραζομένοις βοηθῆσαι.

records.literal_gloss: In which for he has suffered himself having been tested, he is able those being tested to help.

en.L: For in that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} has suffered, having been tested, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is able to help those being tested.
en.B: Having suffered {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} in being tested, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is able to come to the aid of those who are being tested.
en.R: Jesus {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} suffered when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was put to the test. So now {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is able to help others who are being put to the test.

es.L: Porque en cuanto {{deity_pronoun:él mismo|Él mismo}} ha padecido, habiendo sido probado, puede ayudar a los que son probados.
es.B: Por haber sufrido {{deity_pronoun:él mismo|Él mismo}} al ser puesto a prueba, puede socorrer a los que están siendo puestos a prueba.
es.R: Jesús mismo sufrió cuando fue puesto a prueba. Por eso ahora puede ayudar a otros que están siendo puestos a prueba.

fr.L: Car du fait qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} souffert, ayant été éprouvé, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} peut aider ceux qui sont éprouvés.
fr.B: Ayant {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} souffert en étant mis à l’épreuve, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} peut venir en aide à ceux qui sont mis à l’épreuve.
fr.R: Jésus {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} a souffert quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a été mis à l’épreuve. Alors maintenant, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} peut aider les autres qui sont mis à l’épreuve.

sw.L: Kwa maana kwa vile {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} amepitia mateso, akiwa amejaribiwa, anaweza kuwasaidia wale wanaojaribiwa.
sw.B: Kwa kuwa {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} aliteseka katika kujaribiwa, anaweza kuwafikia kwa msaada wale wanaojaribiwa.
sw.R: Yesu {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} aliteseka alipojaribiwa. Kwa hiyo sasa anaweza kuwasaidia wengine wanaojaribiwa.

vi.L: Vì chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã chịu khổ khi bị thử thách, nên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} có thể giúp đỡ những người đang bị thử thách.
vi.B: Vì chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã chịu khổ khi bị thử thách, nên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} có thể cứu giúp những người đang bị thử thách.
vi.R: Chính Đức Giê-xu đã chịu khổ khi bị thử thách. Vì vậy, bây giờ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} có thể giúp những người khác đang bị thử thách.

ko.L: 그분 자신이 시험을 받으시면서 고난을 당하셨으므로, 시험을 받는 사람들을 도우실 수 있습니다.
ko.B: 그분은 몸소 시험을 받으시며 고난을 겪으셨으므로, 시험을 받고 있는 사람들을 도우실 수 있습니다.
ko.R: 예수께서는 시험을 받으실 때 직접 고난을 겪으셨습니다. 그래서 이제 시험을 받고 있는 다른 사람들을 도우실 수 있습니다.

pt.L: Pois, naquilo em que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} mesmo sofreu, tendo sido provado, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} é capaz de ajudar os que estão sendo provados.
pt.B: Tendo {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} mesmo sofrido ao ser provado, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} pode socorrer os que estão sendo provados.
pt.R: O próprio Jesus sofreu quando foi posto à prova. Por isso agora {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} pode ajudar os outros que estão sendo postos à prova.

am.L: እርሱ ራሱ ተፈትኖ መከራን ስለ ተቀበለ፣ የሚፈተኑትን ሊረዳ ይችላልና።
am.B: እርሱ ራሱ በመፈተን መከራን ስለ ተቀበለ፣ የሚፈተኑትን ሊደርስላቸው ይችላል።
am.R: ኢየሱስ ራሱ በተፈተነ ጊዜ መከራን ተቀበለ። ስለዚህ አሁን የሚፈተኑትን ሌሎችን ሊረዳ ይችላል።

decisions.choice: tested: put to the test by suffering, which includes the pull to turn away from God's will
decisions.reason: πειράζω covers both "test" and "tempt". Here the testing is joined to suffering: Jesus felt the full pressure of pain and the fear of death to turn from the path God had given him (5:7-8; 12:2-3). In 4:15 the author says he was tested in every way as we are, yet without sin. The readers, under pressure to give up, are being tested in the same way (10:32-36; 12:3-4).

decisions.choice: in that: because
alternatives: in what he suffered when tested
decisions.reason: ἐν ᾧ most likely means "because, since". It could also mean "in the very thing in which": he can help in the very kind of suffering he went through.

decisions.choice: come to the aid of (R: help)
decisions.reason: βοηθέω is "run to help, come to the rescue"; Balanced says "come to the aid of" to keep that sense.

decisions.choice: probado, puesto a prueba
decisions.reason: "Tentar" in Spanish now means mainly to entice someone to do wrong. The meaning decision (m1) is wider: a testing by suffering that includes the pull to turn from God's will, which "probar" and "poner a prueba" cover.

decisions.choice: kujaribiwa (tested; for the whole letter, also 4:15)
decisions.reason: "Kujaribu" covers both being put to the test and being tempted, which together are what meaning decision m1 describes. "Kushawishiwa" would say only being enticed to do wrong.

decisions.choice: éprouvé (L); mis à l’épreuve (B, R) (for the whole letter, also 4:15)
decisions.reason: The English says "tested": the meaning decision reads the word as being put to the test by suffering, which includes the pull to turn away from God’s will. French "tenter" today points mainly to temptation to do wrong and would narrow that sense, so French uses "éprouver" and "mettre à l’épreuve", here and in 4:15.

decisions.choice: "thử thách" for "tested" (also 4:15)
decisions.reason: The testing is suffering that includes the pull to turn from God's will (m1). "Thử thách" covers both, as in the Vietnamese James (1:2); "cám dỗ" would narrow it to the pull toward sin.

decisions.choice: "시험을 받다" for being tested, at every level
decisions.reason: The word means being put to the test by suffering, which includes the pull to turn from God's will (meaning decision, footnoted). Korean "시험" holds both the trial and the temptation, as in the Korean Gospels' "시험을 받으셨다" (Luke 4:2); "유혹" would keep only the second.

decisions.choice: provado (L, B); posto à prova (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book (also 4:15): "provar" covers the testing by suffering that m1 describes, which includes the pull away from God's will; "tentado" would narrow it to temptation to sin.
